department_translations.name: Oil and Gas Refining Technology
department_translations.description:
Since 2001-2002 academic year on the basis of Bukhara Autonomous Okrug and Yesti, the Department of Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing has been organized. The purpose of the creation of the department in this region was to provide qualified personnel to the Bukhara oil refinery, the Mubarak gas refinery, the Gazlineftegaziburization department and other enterprises. Originally a PhD in Chemistry. M. Mardonov headed the department. From 2002 to 2009, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences Q.K.Jumaev. From 2009 to 2011, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences J.A.Qalandarov.
On April 15, 2013, in accordance with the decree PP-1954 "On the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technical Institute", the Department of "Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business" was formed from the merger of the departments "Technology of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business". From that day until January 2, 2014, the department was headed by PhD in technical sciences B.Z.Adizov. From January 2, 2014 to July 20, 2014, Ph.D. Sharipov worked as acting head of the department. From July 20, 2014 to July 10, 2019, Professor G. R. Bozorov headed the department.
On July 10, 2019, three departments ("Oil Refining Technology", "Gas Chemical Processing Technology" and "Oil and Gas Business") were established on the basis of the Department of Petroleum and Gas Chemical Industry Technology, which was approved by the Ministry of Secondary Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan. From January 28, 2022, the department was headed by Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) A.A. Alimov, and from 2023 to 2025, associate professor Sh.N. Ataullayev.
In accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara State Technical University" from April 10, 2025, Ph.D. R.R. Hayitov worked as the head of the department. From September 13, 2025 to the present, the department has been headed by Ph.D., associate professor. A.A.Ochilov is in charge.

department_translations.description:
Since 2001-2002 academic year on the basis of Bukhara Autonomous Okrug and Yesti, the Department of Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing has been organized. The purpose of the creation of the department in this region was to provide qualified personnel to the Bukhara oil refinery, the Mubarak gas refinery, the Gazlineftegaziburization department and other enterprises. Originally a PhD in Chemistry. M. Mardonov headed the department. From 2002 to 2009, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences Q.K.Jumaev. From 2009 to 2011, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences J.A.Qalandarov.
On April 15, 2013, in accordance with the decree PP-1954 "On the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technical Institute", the Department of "Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business" was formed from the merger of the departments "Technology of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business". From that day until January 2, 2014, the department was headed by PhD in technical sciences B.Z.Adizov. From January 2, 2014 to July 20, 2014, Ph.D. Sharipov worked as acting head of the department. From July 20, 2014 to July 10, 2019, Professor G. R. Bozorov headed the department.
On July 10, 2019, three departments ("Oil Refining Technology", "Gas Chemical Processing Technology" and "Oil and Gas Business") were established on the basis of the Department of Petroleum and Gas Chemical Industry Technology, which was approved by the Ministry of Secondary Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan. From January 28, 2022, the department was headed by Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) A.A. Alimov, and from 2023 to 2025, associate professor Sh.N. Ataullayev.
In accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara State Technical University" from April 10, 2025, Ph.D. R.R. Hayitov worked as the head of the department. From September 13, 2025 to the present, the department has been headed by Ph.D., associate professor. A.A.Ochilov is in charge.

department_translations.description:
Since 2001-2002 academic year on the basis of Bukhara Autonomous Okrug and Yesti, the Department of Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing has been organized. The purpose of the creation of the department in this region was to provide qualified personnel to the Bukhara oil refinery, the Mubarak gas refinery, the Gazlineftegaziburization department and other enterprises. Originally a PhD in Chemistry. M. Mardonov headed the department. From 2002 to 2009, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences Q.K.Jumaev. From 2009 to 2011, the department was headed by PhD of Technical Sciences J.A.Qalandarov.
On April 15, 2013, in accordance with the decree PP-1954 "On the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technical Institute", the Department of "Technologies of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business" was formed from the merger of the departments "Technology of Oil and Gas Processing" and "Oil and Gas Business". From that day until January 2, 2014, the department was headed by PhD in technical sciences B.Z.Adizov. From January 2, 2014 to July 20, 2014, Ph.D. Sharipov worked as acting head of the department. From July 20, 2014 to July 10, 2019, Professor G. R. Bozorov headed the department.
On July 10, 2019, three departments ("Oil Refining Technology", "Gas Chemical Processing Technology" and "Oil and Gas Business") were established on the basis of the Department of Petroleum and Gas Chemical Industry Technology, which was approved by the Ministry of Secondary Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan. From January 28, 2022, the department was headed by Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) A.A. Alimov, and from 2023 to 2025, associate professor Sh.N. Ataullayev.
In accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara State Technical University" from April 10, 2025, Ph.D. R.R. Hayitov worked as the head of the department. From September 13, 2025 to the present, the department has been headed by Ph.D., associate professor. A.A.Ochilov is in charge.

Djuraeva N.R., Jabborova S.K. have passed international internship (advanced training) in the disciplines of "Food Technology" in the leading universities of Central Asia. According to this project 5 modern laboratory units are fully equipped.
During the period of project activity the following investments were made to the department:
1. A modern production laboratory "Food technology " is established and training is being conducted External investment was made for educational laboratory furniture (Microbiology, Sensor and Analytical analysis rooms) for 2.148 000 000 UZS Laboratory equipment was provided in the amount of 3.37 000 Euro. Equipped with household appliances and computer equipment for 4.50 000 000 UZS.
For 2022-2023, within the framework of the GIZ-German International Cooperation Organization project "Opening Uzbekistan to the world of wine (OUWOW)", in cooperation with the University of Coimbra, Portugal, in the amount of 200,000 euros, was funded for new teaching materials and advanced training for the field of education "Wine technology".
The department has relations with Dresden State Technical University (Germany), Moscow State University of Food Production (Russia), Tajikistan State Technical University, Osh State Technical University (Kyrgyzstan) and has concluded friendship agreements and is carrying out scientific and practical work.
On the basis of a joint program with Mogilyaov State Food University of the Republic of Belarus, a memorandum was signed on the organization of advanced training and internships for professors and teachers on the basis of a bilateral diploma "Bachelor's degree in food production".
Teaching staff of the department working within the framework of the practical project PZ-2019062124 "Creating technology for the production of mass food products using natural decontaminations" (2022-2023). Funding -400 mln. UZS.
Food consumption is of very important importance in human life. However, the widespread use of modern intensive technologies, the use of chemicals and other non-food additives can be one of the main causes of food spoilage, including their biochemical changes and microbial damage and poisoning.
The development of unprofitable microflora leads to spoilage of finished products, causing significant economic losses for both producers and consumers.
Certain biotechnologically and chemical methods of decontamination have microbostatic characteristics which sometimes fail to ensure the required quality of the product. Research on technological and cost-effective methods of decontamination of products in hot climates is an actual issue, has scientific and practical value.
The practical project "Development of technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oats and bakery products" is planned for 2023-2024. The amount of funding is 1,740 billion soums. The
project is aimed at studying the current importance of functional food products, their role and comparative analysis in developed countries, the development of a technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oatmeal and bread products based on local raw materials, the differences between the developed products and rational food products and the prophylactic and therapeutic properties.
Cooperative Enterprise "Oltin Ear – Hot Bread" LLC is undertaking an award of 50 mln sum on the theme "Development of new types of rye bread recipes and technologies". Commercial contract No. 44-22 was concluded.
The members of the department in cooperation with Tanxo Shirin Servis LLC are working on the topic "Development of Technologies of Flour Products Functional Purpose". Irreplaceable substance increases micronutrients in raw materials, improves the quality of extracted products, improves their nutritional value. Work is underway to improve the composition of cake and biscuit products by adding natural fruits, produce a vitamin-rich product with reduced calorie content, and develop a product recipe. Test batches of the product are being produced.
Doctoral student of our department Djuraeva N.R. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Scientific and practical aspects of targeted combination of raw materials in the production of vegetable and oil mixtures". The thesis work is the development of scientifically based recipes and resource-saving technologies of vegetable-oil composition mixtures, the biopotential of which is predicted in advance, while the rational use of natural additives with natural stabilizers that increase the physiological value of bread and bakery products, quality indicators, shelf life, save the basic raw materials. The subject of the research was the development of innovative resource-intensive technology for the production of functional plant-fat compositions using environmentally friendly plant raw materials, while the object of the research was oils and vegetable oils, flax, soybean products, emulsion and anhydrous oil-and-paste mixtures, bread and flour products.
The department conducts scientific work by the basic doctoral student Muzafarova H.M. on the theme: "The use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for flour confectionery products for heroditic nutrition." In the development and creation of functional foods for herodietary purposes, one should know the chemical composition, nutritional value and special processing techniques of raw materials. In this context, the urgent task facing all branches of the food industry is to expand the range of products of food for herodietic purpose and improve technology through the use of natural, affordable raw materials and materials that meet the requirements of nutrition. The thesis proposes an approach to solutions, consisting of practical recommendations for the use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for bakery products for herodietic nutrition, which provides an increase in biotechnological potential, sets scientific tasks and substantiates it.
Assistant of the department Ismatova Sh.N. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Rational use of non-traditional means in feed feed". The purpose of the study is to improve the technology of production of feed with high nutritional value using unconventional feed means. Kuliyev N.Sh., dos. Atamuratova T.I., Ph.D. Azimov O'N., PhD. Djuraeva N.R., Jabborova S.K. have passed international internship (advanced training) in the disciplines of "Food Technology" in the leading universities of Central Asia. According to this project 5 modern laboratory units are fully equipped.
During the period of project activity the following investments were made to the department:
1. A modern production laboratory "Food technology " is established and training is being conducted External investment was made for educational laboratory furniture (Microbiology, Sensor and Analytical analysis rooms) for 2.148 000 000 UZS Laboratory equipment was provided in the amount of 3.37 000 Euro. Equipped with household appliances and computer equipment for 4.50 000 000 UZS.
For 2022-2023, within the framework of the GIZ-German International Cooperation Organization project "Opening Uzbekistan to the world of wine (OUWOW)", in cooperation with the University of Coimbra, Portugal, in the amount of 200,000 euros, was funded for new teaching materials and advanced training for the field of education "Wine technology".
The department has relations with Dresden State Technical University (Germany), Moscow State University of Food Production (Russia), Tajikistan State Technical University, Osh State Technical University (Kyrgyzstan) and has concluded friendship agreements and is carrying out scientific and practical work.
On the basis of a joint program with Mogilyaov State Food University of the Republic of Belarus, a memorandum was signed on the organization of advanced training and internships for professors and teachers on the basis of a bilateral diploma "Bachelor's degree in food production".
Teaching staff of the department working within the framework of the practical project PZ-2019062124 "Creating technology for the production of mass food products using natural decontaminations" (2022-2023). Funding -400 mln. UZS.
Food consumption is of very important importance in human life. However, the widespread use of modern intensive technologies, the use of chemicals and other non-food additives can be one of the main causes of food spoilage, including their biochemical changes and microbial damage and poisoning.
The development of unprofitable microflora leads to spoilage of finished products, causing significant economic losses for both producers and consumers.
Certain biotechnologically and chemical methods of decontamination have microbostatic characteristics which sometimes fail to ensure the required quality of the product. Research on technological and cost-effective methods of decontamination of products in hot climates is an actual issue, has scientific and practical value.
The practical project "Development of technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oats and bakery products" is planned for 2023-2024. The amount of funding is 1,740 billion soums. The
project is aimed at studying the current importance of functional food products, their role and comparative analysis in developed countries, the development of a technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oatmeal and bread products based on local raw materials, the differences between the developed products and rational food products and the prophylactic and therapeutic properties.
Cooperative Enterprise "Oltin Ear – Hot Bread" LLC is undertaking an award of 50 mln sum on the theme "Development of new types of rye bread recipes and technologies". Commercial contract No. 44-22 was concluded.
The members of the department in cooperation with Tanxo Shirin Servis LLC are working on the topic "Development of Technologies of Flour Products Functional Purpose". Irreplaceable substance increases micronutrients in raw materials, improves the quality of extracted products, improves their nutritional value. Work is underway to improve the composition of cake and biscuit products by adding natural fruits, produce a vitamin-rich product with reduced calorie content, and develop a product recipe. Test batches of the product are being produced.
Doctoral student of our department Djuraeva N.R. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Scientific and practical aspects of targeted combination of raw materials in the production of vegetable and oil mixtures". The thesis work is the development of scientifically based recipes and resource-saving technologies of vegetable-oil composition mixtures, the biopotential of which is predicted in advance, while the rational use of natural additives with natural stabilizers that increase the physiological value of bread and bakery products, quality indicators, shelf life, save the basic raw materials. The subject of the research was the development of innovative resource-intensive technology for the production of functional plant-fat compositions using environmentally friendly plant raw materials, while the object of the research was oils and vegetable oils, flax, soybean products, emulsion and anhydrous oil-and-paste mixtures, bread and flour products.
The department conducts scientific work by the basic doctoral student Muzafarova H.M. on the theme: "The use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for flour confectionery products for heroditic nutrition." In the development and creation of functional foods for herodietary purposes, one should know the chemical composition, nutritional value and special processing techniques of raw materials. In this context, the urgent task facing all branches of the food industry is to expand the range of products of food for herodietic purpose and improve technology through the use of natural, affordable raw materials and materials that meet the requirements of nutrition. The thesis proposes an approach to solutions, consisting of practical recommendations for the use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for bakery products for herodietic nutrition, which provides an increase in biotechnological potential, sets scientific tasks and substantiates it.
Assistant of the department Ismatova Sh.N. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Rational use of non-traditional means in feed feed". Kuliyev N.Sh., dos. Atamuratova T.I., Ph.D. Azimov O'N., PhD. Djuraeva N.R., Jabborova S.K. have passed international internship (advanced training) in the disciplines of "Food Technology" in the leading universities of Central Asia. According to this project 5 modern laboratory units are fully equipped.
During the period of project activity the following investments were made to the department:
1. A modern production laboratory "Food technology " is established and training is being conducted External investment was made for educational laboratory furniture (Microbiology, Sensor and Analytical analysis rooms) for 2.148 000 000 UZS Laboratory equipment was provided in the amount of 3.37 000 Euro. Equipped with household appliances and computer equipment for 4.50 000 000 UZS.
For 2022-2023, within the framework of the GIZ-German International Cooperation Organization project "Opening Uzbekistan to the world of wine (OUWOW)", in cooperation with the University of Coimbra, Portugal, in the amount of 200,000 euros, was funded for new teaching materials and advanced training for the field of education "Wine technology".
The department has relations with Dresden State Technical University (Germany), Moscow State University of Food Production (Russia), Tajikistan State Technical University, Osh State Technical University (Kyrgyzstan) and has concluded friendship agreements and is carrying out scientific and practical work.
On the basis of a joint program with Mogilyaov State Food University of the Republic of Belarus, a memorandum was signed on the organization of advanced training and internships for professors and teachers on the basis of a bilateral diploma "Bachelor's degree in food production".
Teaching staff of the department working within the framework of the practical project PZ-2019062124 "Creating technology for the production of mass food products using natural decontaminations" (2022-2023). Funding -400 mln. UZS.
Food consumption is of very important importance in human life. However, the widespread use of modern intensive technologies, the use of chemicals and other non-food additives can be one of the main causes of food spoilage, including their biochemical changes and microbial damage and poisoning.
The development of unprofitable microflora leads to spoilage of finished products, causing significant economic losses for both producers and consumers.
Certain biotechnologically and chemical methods of decontamination have microbostatic characteristics which sometimes fail to ensure the required quality of the product. Research on technological and cost-effective methods of decontamination of products in hot climates is an actual issue, has scientific and practical value.
The practical project "Development of technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oats and bakery products" is planned for 2023-2024. The amount of funding is 1,740 billion soums. The
project is aimed at studying the current importance of functional food products, their role and comparative analysis in developed countries, the development of a technology for the production of functionally oriented flour, oatmeal and bread products based on local raw materials, the differences between the developed products and rational food products and the prophylactic and therapeutic properties.
Cooperative Enterprise "Oltin Ear – Hot Bread" LLC is undertaking an award of 50 mln sum on the theme "Development of new types of rye bread recipes and technologies". Commercial contract No. 44-22 was concluded.
The members of the department in cooperation with Tanxo Shirin Servis LLC are working on the topic "Development of Technologies of Flour Products Functional Purpose". Irreplaceable substance increases micronutrients in raw materials, improves the quality of extracted products, improves their nutritional value. Work is underway to improve the composition of cake and biscuit products by adding natural fruits, produce a vitamin-rich product with reduced calorie content, and develop a product recipe. Test batches of the product are being produced.
Doctoral student of our department Djuraeva N.R. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Scientific and practical aspects of targeted combination of raw materials in the production of vegetable and oil mixtures". The thesis work is the development of scientifically based recipes and resource-saving technologies of vegetable-oil composition mixtures, the biopotential of which is predicted in advance, while the rational use of natural additives with natural stabilizers that increase the physiological value of bread and bakery products, quality indicators, shelf life, save the basic raw materials. The subject of the research was the development of innovative resource-intensive technology for the production of functional plant-fat compositions using environmentally friendly plant raw materials, while the object of the research was oils and vegetable oils, flax, soybean products, emulsion and anhydrous oil-and-paste mixtures, bread and flour products.
The department conducts scientific work by the basic doctoral student Muzafarova H.M. on the theme: "The use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for flour confectionery products for heroditic nutrition." In the development and creation of functional foods for herodietary purposes, one should know the chemical composition, nutritional value and special processing techniques of raw materials. In this context, the urgent task facing all branches of the food industry is to expand the range of products of food for herodietic purpose and improve technology through the use of natural, affordable raw materials and materials that meet the requirements of nutrition. The thesis proposes an approach to solutions, consisting of practical recommendations for the use of unconventional raw materials in the development of new recipes for bakery products for herodietic nutrition, which provides an increase in biotechnological potential, sets scientific tasks and substantiates it.
Assistant of the department Ismatova Sh.N. conducts scientific work on the theme: "Rational use of non-traditional means in feed feed". The purpose of the study is to improve the technology of production of feed with high nutritional value using unconventional feed means. The objectives of the research are to analyze and systematize modern data on improving productivity and reproductive qualities of poultry when using unconventional feed and feed additives, to select and substantiate raw material components for feed in the feed, to study their chemical composition, functional and technological properties and nutritional safety, to study the dried quinoa and amaranth grains (seeds) It consists of the development of technological parameters for unconventional methods of preparation and determination of the optimal dosage for their inclusion in the diet of chickens, as well as the study of the growth and development of poultry, meatiness, egg productivity and reproductive properties when using feed with added unconventional additives."]},{"key":"cooperation","title":"التعاون","items":["For the renovation of the scientific laboratory of the department in 2019-2020 with the help of the program "Vocational education in Central Asia-I", 3 new laboratories worth 36 thousand euros were equipped, 150 million soums worth furniture and 60 million soums new equipment.","Within the framework of the project "Opening Uzbekistan to the World of Wine (OUWOW)" in cooperation with the University of Coimbra, Portugal, 2022-2023 Educational direction "Wine technology" for 200 000 euros Funded for new teaching materials and professional development.","JOINT PROGRAMS

department_translations.description:
The Department of Oil and Gas Business was organized on the basis of the Department of "Technology of Oil and Gas Chemical Industry" in accordance with the new structure of the Bukhara Engineering and Technological Institute, approved by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Special Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan on July 10, 2019. The management of the department is entrusted to the candidate of chemical sciences, associate professor Q.Q.Sharipov.
At the department 1 doctor of sciences - professor, 1 candidate of sciences - associate professor, 4 doctors of philosophy (PhD), 2 senior teachers, 2 assistant teachers teach students.
In the 2021-2022 academic year, the Department of Oil and Gas Affairs organized the educational process for the following undergraduate and master's specialties:

At the department 4 doctoral students and more than 5 independent researchers are engaged in research work.

department_translations.description: The department began its activity in August 2019 under the name of "Metrology and standardization" on the basis of the newly created structure of the institute. Trainings specialists in the direction of 5310900 - Metrology, standardization and product quality management. . There are 13 professors and teachers at the department, including 1 candidate of sciences - professor, 6 candidates of science, associate professor, 1 senior teacher, 3 assistants, 2 trainee teachers, scientific potential is 54%. Over the past two years, 2 scientific works (PhD) have been defended, in cooperation with the teachers of the department have published 5 international textbooks (with an impact factor), 3 textbooks, 6 monographs, 19 in 6 journals, 20 articles in the journals of the Supreme Attestation Commission and 5 articles on the basis of Scopus. At the department 4 doctoral students and more than 5 independent researchers are engaged in research work.

department_translations.description: The department began its activity in August 2019 under the name of "Metrology and standardization" on the basis of the newly created structure of the institute. Trainings specialists in the direction of 5310900 - Metrology, standardization and product quality management. . There are 13 professors and teachers at the department, including 1 candidate of sciences - professor, 6 candidates of science, associate professor, 1 senior teacher, 3 assistants, 2 trainee teachers, scientific potential is 54%. Over the past two years, 2 scientific works (PhD) have been defended, in cooperation with the teachers of the department have published 5 international textbooks (with an impact factor), 3 textbooks, 6 monographs, 19 in 6 journals, 20 articles in the journals of the Supreme Attestation Commission and 5 articles on the basis of Scopus. At the department 4 doctoral students and more than 5 independent researchers are engaged in research work.

department_translations.description: In connection with the change in the internal structure of the institute in 2024, the department "Water resources management and melioration" Department "Irrigation and melioration " was organized. According to the order of the rector of the Bukhara Institute of Management of Natural Resources of TIQHMMU No488-12 dated September 20, 2024, the Department of "Irrigation and melioration" was organized. Since September 2024, due to the change in the internal structure of the institute, the departments "Water resources management and melioration" and "Water-saving irrigation technology" have been optimized and the department "Irrigation and melioration" has been organized. The Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara State Technical University" was renamed the Department of "Irrigation and Melioration".

department_translations.description: In connection with the change in the internal structure of the institute in 2024, the department "Water resources management and melioration" Department "Irrigation and melioration " was organized. According to the order of the rector of the Bukhara Institute of Management of Natural Resources of TIQHMMU No488-12 dated September 20, 2024, the Department of "Irrigation and melioration" was organized. Since September 2024, due to the change in the internal structure of the institute, the departments "Water resources management and melioration" and "Water-saving irrigation technology" have been optimized and the department "Irrigation and melioration" has been organized. The Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara State Technical University" was renamed the Department of "Irrigation and Melioration".

Today, they and their associates are working as leading experts in various sectors of the republic. The department has classrooms, laboratories, offices and branches of the department with modern equipment. At the department for 2024-2025 1 DSc and 7 PhD theses have been defended. The main composition of the department are young people, the average age of them is 41 years. At the moment, 18 doctoral students and 3 freelance researchers are conducting research on PhD and DcS dissertations. Their defense is scheduled for 2025-2027. For the duration of the department's activity 2 textbooks and teaching aids for professional colleges, 9 textbooks and more than 10 teaching aids for universities, more than 10 author's certificates for software have been obtained.
The department has 21 staff units, of which 16 teachers are the main contribution. In 2025-2026 academic year, 5 doctors of sciences, professors, 8 PhDs, 3 senior teachers, 4 assistants and 3 trainee teachers carried out educational-methodological, research and spiritual and educational work. department_translations.description:
The basis of the department "Agricultural and water management technique technology" was established as a higher educational institution in the education system of the Republic of Uzbekistan on August 20, 2010 under the name of the department "General professional sciences, mechanization of water economy and melioration works", then due to the insufficient number of quotas of the branch, it was named under the department "Hydromelioration" The first department was appointed Acting Head of the department, Ph.D., associate professor Hasanov I.S. Lessons are conducted in the following subjects, relevant to the department.
Due to the lack of specialized teachers in the newly created department, professors and teachers from the former Tashkent Institute of Irrigation and Melioration (TIMI) and Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technologies (Bux OO and Yesti) came to the department and provided methodological consultations to the teachers of the department.
In 2010-2011 academic year there were 7 professors and 2 technical staff at the department, including 5 candidates of science, associate professors and 2 assistant teachers, whose scientific potential was 71%. Professor-teachers who worked at the department during that period are listed below.

The basis of the department "Agricultural and water management technique technology" was established as a higher educational institution in the education system of the Republic of Uzbekistan on August 20, 2010 under the name of the department "General professional sciences, mechanization of water economy and melioration works", then due to the insufficient number of quotas of the branch, it was named under the department "Hydromelioration" The first department was appointed Acting Head of the department, Ph.D., associate professor Hasanov I.S. Lessons are conducted in the following subjects, relevant to the department.
Due to the lack of specialized teachers in the newly created department, professors and teachers from the former Tashkent Institute of Irrigation and Melioration (TIMI) and Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technologies (Bux OO and Yesti) came to the department and provided methodological consultations to the teachers of the department.
In 2010-2011 academic year there were 7 professors and 2 technical staff at the department, including 5 candidates of science, associate professors and 2 assistant teachers, whose scientific potential was 71%. Professor-teachers who worked at the department during that period are listed below.

department_translations.name: Department of Land Use and State Cadastre
department_translations.description:
Taking into account the growing scale of tasks of improving the land reclamation state, as well as the peculiarities of the soil and climatic conditions, mineralization and salinity of agricultural lands in certain regions, including in the Bukhara valley, and in order to train highly qualified specialists for this important area of the country's economy, the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan approved the Decree of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated August 20, 2010 "Tashkent irrigation and On the organization of the Bukhara branch of the Institute of Melioration "The Department of Land Management and Land Cadastre" was organized as part of the organizational structure of the faculty "Hydromelioration".
The department was organized with the name "Land Planning and Land Cadastre" in 2010. At present, it is called "Land Use and State Cadastres". Prominent scientists - professors S. Boriev and U. Tadzhiev made a great contribution to the development of the department for a long time. The department is headed by associate professor F. Hamidov, associate professor I. Islamov, and since 2022, associate professor S. Asatov. Based on their specialties, the faculty of the department "Land Resources Use and State Cadastres" are engaged in various problems in agriculture.
In recent years, the department has paid special attention to the introduction of scientific results into the academic process. The results of scientific research are widely used in the performance of lecture, laboratory and practice lessons, as well as in the preparation of course designs, training and production practice. The department is given : Cabinet of Ministers Resolution of 824 "On the procedure for introducing the credit-modular system in the educational process in higher education institutions" and all the law "On Education" adopted by the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan on higher education, It works in accordance with the decisions of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Currently, the department is organized in accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 "Bukhara State Technical Laboratory Decree No. PQ-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technological Institute and the Bukhara Institute of Management of Natural Resources in the Bukhara State Technical University" has its activity.
The professors and teachers of the department have introduced electronic textbooks, teaching aids, lecture texts, methodological instructions, control questions and test suites for use in the "Ziyonet" and international Internet networks. Video lessons in all subjects are constantly posted on YouTube.
The department includes "Land cadastre and land management", "Geodesy and geoinformatics", "Ecology and environmental protection", "Hydrology", "Hydrology", "Mechanics of water management and meliorationleveling "," Hydrotechnical facilities and the use of pumping stations "and other areas of education give lectures and practical lessons. Today, due to the peculiarities of the disciplines taught in the department, lessons are used with the use of "presentation", "Mental attack", "Discussion", "6x6x6", "Black box" and other types of pedagogical technology.

department_translations.description:
Taking into account the growing scale of tasks of improving the land reclamation state, as well as the peculiarities of the soil and climatic conditions, mineralization and salinity of agricultural lands in certain regions, including in the Bukhara valley, and in order to train highly qualified specialists for this important area of the country's economy, the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan approved the Decree of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated August 20, 2010 "Tashkent irrigation and On the organization of the Bukhara branch of the Institute of Melioration "The Department of Land Management and Land Cadastre" was organized as part of the organizational structure of the faculty "Hydromelioration".
The department was organized with the name "Land Planning and Land Cadastre" in 2010. At present, it is called "Land Use and State Cadastres". Prominent scientists - professors S. Boriev and U. Tadzhiev made a great contribution to the development of the department for a long time. The department is headed by associate professor F. Hamidov, associate professor I. Islamov, and since 2022, associate professor S. Asatov. Based on their specialties, the faculty of the department "Land Resources Use and State Cadastres" are engaged in various problems in agriculture.
In recent years, the department has paid special attention to the introduction of scientific results into the academic process. The results of scientific research are widely used in the performance of lecture, laboratory and practice lessons, as well as in the preparation of course designs, training and production practice. The department is given : Cabinet of Ministers Resolution of 824 "On the procedure for introducing the credit-modular system in the educational process in higher education institutions" and all the law "On Education" adopted by the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan on higher education, It works in accordance with the decisions of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Currently, the department is organized in accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 "Bukhara State Technical Laboratory Decree No. PQ-22 "On the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technological Institute and the Bukhara Institute of Management of Natural Resources in the Bukhara State Technical University" has its activity.
The professors and teachers of the department have introduced electronic textbooks, teaching aids, lecture texts, methodological instructions, control questions and test suites for use in the "Ziyonet" and international Internet networks. Video lessons in all subjects are constantly posted on YouTube.
The department includes "Land cadastre and land management", "Geodesy and geoinformatics", "Ecology and environmental protection", "Hydrology", "Hydrology", "Mechanics of water management and meliorationleveling "," Hydrotechnical facilities and the use of pumping stations "and other areas of education give lectures and practical lessons. Today, due to the peculiarities of the disciplines taught in the department, lessons are used with the use of "presentation", "Mental attack", "Discussion", "6x6x6", "Black box" and other types of pedagogical technology.

department_translations.name: Department of Industrial Ecology and Hydrogeology
department_translations.description:
According to the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025 No. PP-22 "On the organization of the Bukhara State Technical University", as a result of the reorganization of the departments of Industrial Ecology and Ecology of the Bukhara Engineering Technological Institute and the Department of Hydrology of the Bukhara Institute of Natural Resources Management, the Department of Industrial Ecology and Hydrology was started. Department Due to the need for specialists with higher education with modern knowledge and skills for the sectors of the economy of the Bukhara region, including manufacturing, engineering, oil and gas, transport and logistics, green economy, environmental problems, inclusiveness, socio-economic development of regions, Reclamation Hydrogeology, Hydrology (hydrology of rivers and reservoirs), Ecology and environmental protection (water management), Ecology and Labor Bachelor's and Master's programs in the fields of protection and safety, Occupational health and safety (by industry).
Professors and teachers of the Department of Industrial Ecology and Hydrology based on the following specialties: "Industrial ecology" (for all technical and technological directions), "Life safety and work protection", "Construction ecology", "Ecology", "Life safety "(for all technical and technological directions), "Labor protection and ecology", "Industrial sanitation and labor hygiene", "Emergency management of economic facilities protection", "Fire and explosion safety", "Occupational health and safety management", "Reliability in man-made risk and technical systems", "Life safety and environmental protection", "Psychology and culture of labor protection", "Innovative technologies in industry", "Labor protection and technical safety", "Engineering ecology", "Radiation safety", "Occupational health and safety and construction ecology", "Labor protection and technical safety", and rivers, lakes, Glacier Hydrology, Environmental Impact Assessment, Engineering Geology, Hydrogeology, Drilling and Irrigation Wells, SOF, SOG, Land Hydrology, Climatology, Instrumental Methods of Analysis, Ecology and Water Law, Hydrochemistry, Environmental Monitoring, Environmental Monitoring, Ecology and Environmental Protection, Meliorative Hydrology, Geology and Hydrogeology, Water Law, Monitoring of Water Extraction Wells, Meliorative Hydrology, Engineering Hydrology, Hydrography of Central Asia, Water Body Management, Waste Management, Environmental Engineering, International and State Water Relations, Hydrometry, Exploration Hydrometry, Groundwater Flow, Drilling, GAT and Hydrology on the basis of standard and working programs.

Department Due to the need for specialists with higher education with modern knowledge and skills for the sectors of the economy of the Bukhara region, including manufacturing, engineering, oil and gas, transport and logistics, green economy, environmental problems, inclusiveness, socio-economic development of regions, Reclamation Hydrogeology, Hydrology (hydrology of rivers and reservoirs), Ecology and environmental protection (water management), Ecology and Labor Bachelor's and Master's programs in the fields of protection and safety, Occupational health and safety (by industry).
Professors and teachers of the Department of Industrial Ecology and Hydrology based on the following specialties: "Industrial ecology" (for all technical and technological directions), "Life safety and work protection", "Construction ecology", "Ecology", "Life safety "(for all technical and technological directions), "Labor protection and ecology", "Industrial sanitation and labor hygiene", "Emergency management of economic facilities protection", "Fire and explosion safety", "Occupational health and safety management", "Reliability in man-made risk and technical systems", "Life safety and environmental protection", "Psychology and culture of labor protection", "Innovative technologies in industry", "Labor protection and technical safety", "Engineering ecology", "Radiation safety", "Occupational health and safety and construction ecology", "Labor protection and technical safety", and rivers, lakes, Glacier Hydrology, Environmental Impact Assessment, Engineering Geology, Hydrogeology, Drilling and Irrigation Wells, SOF, SOG, Land Hydrology, Climatology, Instrumental Methods of Analysis, Ecology and Water Law, Hydrochemistry, Environmental Monitoring, Environmental Monitoring, Ecology and Environmental Protection, Meliorative Hydrology, Geology and Hydrogeology, Water Law, Monitoring of Water Extraction Wells, Meliorative Hydrology, Engineering Hydrology, Hydrography of Central Asia, Water Body Management, Waste Management, Environmental Engineering, International and State Water Relations, Hydrometry, Exploration Hydrometry, Groundwater Flow, Drilling, GAT and Hydrology on the basis of standard and working programs.

1. Introduction of curricula and literature of foreign higher educational institutions, included in the TOP-300 list.
2. Improvement of curricula and relevant regulatory documents in the organization of the educational process in accordance with international standards and requirements of customers of personnel
3. Introduction of a system of training specialists on the basis of joint educational programs together with leading foreign higher education institutions ranking TOP-500.
4. Implementation of the dual form of education in cooperation with foreign organizations (enterprises) in selected areas on the basis of foreign experience.
5. Introduction of a system of education of students based on the DUAL education model in order to improve the quality of training.
6. Creation of new generation educational literature, their introduction in the educational process, and to constantly update the fund of the Information Resource Center.
7. The development of students' critical and creative thinking, systematic analysis and entrepreneurial skills.
8. Organization and regulation of branches of specialty departments on the basis of partner organizations.
9. Organization of short-term advanced training (internship) of professors and teachers of specialty subjects in production enterprises and organizations of the republic.
10. Expansion of mutually beneficial and fruitful cooperation with leading foreign higher education institutions.
11. Improving the criteria for assessing students' knowledge, skills and qualifications.
12. Expanding the contingent of international students by attracting foreign students to study and organizing the teaching staff of the department in foreign universities.
13. Organization of the academic process for students of foreign and domestic universities within the framework of academic mobility programs;
14. To ensure that university graduates find their place in society as competitively qualified personnel.
15. Focusing scientific research on solving problems of networks and expanding their integration and ensuring their effectiveness.
16. Increasing the scope of scientific work through the organization of scientific internships for researchers.
17. Identification of available opportunities for scientific capacity and taking appropriate measures.
18. Formation of promising university research areas of special attention to regional problems and orientation of research works of master's and doctoral students to the problems of economics, renewable energy, poverty alleviation.
19. Increase the publication of professors in journals indexed by Web of Science and Scopus databases.

The establishment of this department arose from the need to train highly qualified specialists in the field of modern transport systems, agricultural engineering and mechanical engineering. As the head of the Department of "Vehicle engineering" is docent. Kh.R. Gaffarov works.","Since 2021, the department has been renamed "Department of Vehicle Engineering" in accordance with the field. The name of the department was changed in order to expand the scientific and pedagogical activity of the department, to cover modern directions in the field of transport engineering and to bring the educational process into line with international requirements. In the initial period of creation of the department there were two directions, namely:
60810100 - Mechanization of agriculture,
• 5310600 - Land transport systems and their operation (motor transport).
During that period, 8 professors and teachers worked at the department. They include 1 associate professor, 2 senior lecturers, 3 assistants and 2 trainee teachers. At the department, education at the bachelor's level was initially provided, but the master's degree was not provided. In subsequent years, scientific and pedagogical potential and material and technical base of the department were significantly developed. As a result, the number of areas of education has been expanded, and today the department trains highly qualified personnel in 9 directions of education at the undergraduate level and 3 specialties at the master's level. Currently, 36 professors and staff work at the department. They include 1 professor, 12 associate professors, 3 senior lecturers, 7 assistants, 12 trainee teachers, and 2 laboratory assistants. The scientific and pedagogical team of the department pays special attention to the organization of the educational process on the basis of modern pedagogical technologies, strengthening the integration with the development and production of scientific research. In order to improve the educational process, the professors and teachers of the department have compiled more than 20 textbooks and teaching aids. They also publish a lot of scientific articles in national and international scientific journals and conduct research works in such areas as vehicle engineering, agricultural engineering, transport systems operation. Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha 5 yillik istiqbolli rivojlanish rejasi (2026–2030)
Jahon iqtisodiyotida transport tizimi muhim strategik tarmoqlardan biri hisoblanadi. Ayniqsa avtomobil transporti sohasi jadal sur’atlarda rivojlanib, yangi texnologiyalar, raqamli boshqaruv tizimlari va ekologik talablar bilan boyib bormoqda. Elektr transport vositalari, intellektual transport tizimlari, avtomatlashtirilgan boshqaruv va raqamli diagnostika kabi innovatsion texnologiyalar transport sohasini tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda. O‘zbekiston Respublikasida ham transport infratuzilmasini modernizatsiya qilish, logistika tizimini takomillashtirish va zamonaviy transport texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo‘yicha keng ko‘lamli islohotlar amalga oshirilmoqda. Bu esa transport sohasi uchun yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlashni yanada takomillashtirish zaruratini keltirib chiqaradi. “Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” ta’lim yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini rivojlantirish, ta’lim mazmunini zamonaviy talablarga moslashtirish va ilmiy tadqiqotlar salohiyatini oshirish mazkur strategiyaning asosiy vazifalaridan hisoblanadi.
Rejaning asosiy maqsadi: Oliy ta’lim muassasalarida transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) sohasi bo‘yicha zamonaviy bilim, amaliy ko‘nikma va innovatsion fikrlashga ega mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini takomillashtirish, hamda transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) ta’lim yo‘nalishini xalqaro standartlar asosida rivojlantirish, raqobatbardosh muhandis kadrlar tayyorlash tizimini shakllantirishdan iborat.
Asosiy vazifalar sifatida quyidagi mezonlar qabul qilindi.
1.ta’lim dasturlarini xalqaro standartlar asosida yangilash
2.zamonaviy laboratoriya va o‘quv bazasini rivojlantirish
3.sanoat korxonalari bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish
4.raqamli texnologiyalar va “yashil transport” yo‘nalishlarini joriy etish
5.professor-o‘qituvchilarning ilmiy salohiyatini oshirish
6.talabalarning amaliy va innovatsion faolligini kuchaytirish
7. xalqaro hamkorlik va akademik mobillikni rivojlantirish
I. 5 yillik bosqichma-bosqich rivojlanish rejasi
1-yil (2026) – Ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish
Asosiy yo‘nalishlar:
1.O‘quv rejalarini xalqaro standartlar (ABET, EUR-ACE) asosida qayta ko‘rib chiqish
2.Zamonaviy fanlarni kiritish:
A)Elektr va gibrid avtomobillar
V)Avtomobil elektronikasi
S)Intellektual transport tizimlari
D)CAD/CAE modellashtirish
3.o‘quv jarayoniga raqamli platformalarni joriy qilish
4.korxonalar bilan dual ta’lim mexanizmlarini ishlab chiqish
Ta’lim jarayonini raqamlashtirish izchil amalga oshiriladi. Raqamli texnologiyalar ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish imkonini beradi. Bunda asosiy yo‘nalishlar elektron ta’lim platformalari, virtual laboratoriyalar, transport tizimlarini modellashtirish dasturlari, hamda masofaviy ta’lim tizimi amalga oshiriladi. Birinchi yil ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish oqali yangilangan bakalavr ta’lim dasturi va sanoat talablariga mos kompetensiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
2-yil (2027) – Moddiy-texnik bazani kuchaytirish Ikkinchi yilda quyidagi tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi. Bunda yangi laboratoriyalarni tashkil etish nazarda tutilgan:
1.Avtomobil diagnostikasi laboratoriyasi
2.Elektromobillar laboratoriyasi
3.Dvigatellar sinov laboratoriyasi
4.Avtomobil elektronikasi laboratoriyasi
5.simulyator va virtual laboratoriyalar joriy etish
6.CAD/CAM/CAE dasturlari (SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) bilan ta’minlash
7.Transport modellashtirish markazi
Infratuzilmani modernizatsiya qilish
Ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish uchun zamonaviy infratuzilma zarur bo‘ladi. Ikkinchi yilda Kutilayotgan natijalar amaliyotga yo‘naltirilgan ta’limni shakllantirish va talabalarning muhandislik ko‘nikmalari oshirishdan iborat.
3-yil (2028) – Ilmiy tadqiqot va innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish
Amalga oshiriladigan tadbirlar:
• “Innovatsion transport texnologiyalari” ilmiy markazini tashkil etish
• talabalar startap loyihalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash
• ilmiy grantlar va xalqaro loyihalarda ishtirok
• ilmiy jurnallarda maqolalar sonini oshirish
Asosiy tadqiqot yo‘nalishlari: elektr transport, yoqilg‘i tejamkor dvigatellar, ekologik transport intellektual transport tizimlari Uchinchi yilda ilmiy ishlanmalar patentlar va innovatsion loyihalar amalga oshiriladi. Sanoat bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish orqali ta’lim tizimini ishlab chiqarish bilan integratsiya qilish kadrlar tayyorlash samaradorligini oshiradi. Bu borada: • transport korxonalari bilan hamkorlik shartnomalari tuzish;
• dual ta’lim tizimini joriy qilish;
• talabalarni ishlab chiqarish amaliyotlariga keng jalb qilish;
• korxona mutaxassislarini ta’lim jarayoniga jalb qilish rejalashtiriladi.
• Ishlab chiqarishdagi muammolar o‘rganiladi va mummolarni yechimlari bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
Ilmiy tadqiqot faoliyati rivojlantiriladi. Ilmiy tadqiqotlar transport sohasidagi innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish uchun xizmat qiladi. Asosiy yo‘nalishlari sifatida energiya samarador transport vositalari, ekologik toza transport, avtomobil diagnostikasi tizimlari va transport logistikasini optimallashtirish kabi yo‘nalishlar kiritildi.
4-yil (2029) – Xalqaro hamkorlikni kengaytirish
Tadbirlar:
• xorijiy universitetlar bilan qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari
• akademik almashinuv dasturlari

5-yil (2030) – Ta’lim sifati va barqaror rivojlanish
Tadbirlar:
• ta’lim dasturini xalqaro akkreditatsiyadan o‘tkazish

Beshinchi yilda kutiladigan natijalar xalqaro tan olingan ta’lim dasturi va yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlanishiga erishiladi. Ta’lim jarayoniga raqamli texnologiyalarni joriy qilish talabalarning bilim olish imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi. Bunda onlayn ta’lim platformalarini joriy qilish; virtual laboratoriyalardan foydalanish; raqamli ta’lim resurslarini ishlab chiqish nazarda tutiladi.

Jahon iqtisodiyotida transport tizimi muhim strategik tarmoqlardan biri hisoblanadi. Ayniqsa avtomobil transporti sohasi jadal sur’atlarda rivojlanib, yangi texnologiyalar, raqamli boshqaruv tizimlari va ekologik talablar bilan boyib bormoqda. Elektr transport vositalari, intellektual transport tizimlari, avtomatlashtirilgan boshqaruv va raqamli diagnostika kabi innovatsion texnologiyalar transport sohasini tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda. O‘zbekiston Respublikasida ham transport infratuzilmasini modernizatsiya qilish, logistika tizimini takomillashtirish va zamonaviy transport texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo‘yicha keng ko‘lamli islohotlar amalga oshirilmoqda. Bu esa transport sohasi uchun yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlashni yanada takomillashtirish zaruratini keltirib chiqaradi. “Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” ta’lim yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini rivojlantirish, ta’lim mazmunini zamonaviy talablarga moslashtirish va ilmiy tadqiqotlar salohiyatini oshirish mazkur strategiyaning asosiy vazifalaridan hisoblanadi.
Rejaning asosiy maqsadi: Oliy ta’lim muassasalarida transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) sohasi bo‘yicha zamonaviy bilim, amaliy ko‘nikma va innovatsion fikrlashga ega mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini takomillashtirish, hamda transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) ta’lim yo‘nalishini xalqaro standartlar asosida rivojlantirish, raqobatbardosh muhandis kadrlar tayyorlash tizimini shakllantirishdan iborat.
Asosiy vazifalar sifatida quyidagi mezonlar qabul qilindi.
1.ta’lim dasturlarini xalqaro standartlar asosida yangilash
2.zamonaviy laboratoriya va o‘quv bazasini rivojlantirish
3.sanoat korxonalari bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish
4.raqamli texnologiyalar va “yashil transport” yo‘nalishlarini joriy etish
5.professor-o‘qituvchilarning ilmiy salohiyatini oshirish
6.talabalarning amaliy va innovatsion faolligini kuchaytirish
7. xalqaro hamkorlik va akademik mobillikni rivojlantirish
I. 5 yillik bosqichma-bosqich rivojlanish rejasi
1-yil (2026) – Ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish
Asosiy yo‘nalishlar:
1.O‘quv rejalarini xalqaro standartlar (ABET, EUR-ACE) asosida qayta ko‘rib chiqish
2.Zamonaviy fanlarni kiritish:
A)Elektr va gibrid avtomobillar
V)Avtomobil elektronikasi
S)Intellektual transport tizimlari
D)CAD/CAE modellashtirish
3.o‘quv jarayoniga raqamli platformalarni joriy qilish
4.korxonalar bilan dual ta’lim mexanizmlarini ishlab chiqish
Ta’lim jarayonini raqamlashtirish izchil amalga oshiriladi. Raqamli texnologiyalar ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish imkonini beradi. Bunda asosiy yo‘nalishlar elektron ta’lim platformalari, virtual laboratoriyalar, transport tizimlarini modellashtirish dasturlari, hamda masofaviy ta’lim tizimi amalga oshiriladi. Birinchi yil ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish oqali yangilangan bakalavr ta’lim dasturi va sanoat talablariga mos kompetensiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
2-yil (2027) – Moddiy-texnik bazani kuchaytirish Ikkinchi yilda quyidagi tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi. Bunda yangi laboratoriyalarni tashkil etish nazarda tutilgan:
1.Avtomobil diagnostikasi laboratoriyasi
2.Elektromobillar laboratoriyasi
3.Dvigatellar sinov laboratoriyasi
4.Avtomobil elektronikasi laboratoriyasi
5.simulyator va virtual laboratoriyalar joriy etish
6.CAD/CAM/CAE dasturlari (SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) bilan ta’minlash
7.Transport modellashtirish markazi
Infratuzilmani modernizatsiya qilish
Ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish uchun zamonaviy infratuzilma zarur bo‘ladi. Ikkinchi yilda Kutilayotgan natijalar amaliyotga yo‘naltirilgan ta’limni shakllantirish va talabalarning muhandislik ko‘nikmalari oshirishdan iborat.
3-yil (2028) – Ilmiy tadqiqot va innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish
Amalga oshiriladigan tadbirlar:
• “Innovatsion transport texnologiyalari” ilmiy markazini tashkil etish
• talabalar startap loyihalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash
• ilmiy grantlar va xalqaro loyihalarda ishtirok
• ilmiy jurnallarda maqolalar sonini oshirish
Asosiy tadqiqot yo‘nalishlari: elektr transport, yoqilg‘i tejamkor dvigatellar, ekologik transport intellektual transport tizimlari Uchinchi yilda ilmiy ishlanmalar patentlar va innovatsion loyihalar amalga oshiriladi. Sanoat bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish orqali ta’lim tizimini ishlab chiqarish bilan integratsiya qilish kadrlar tayyorlash samaradorligini oshiradi. Bu borada: • transport korxonalari bilan hamkorlik shartnomalari tuzish;
• dual ta’lim tizimini joriy qilish;
• talabalarni ishlab chiqarish amaliyotlariga keng jalb qilish;
• korxona mutaxassislarini ta’lim jarayoniga jalb qilish rejalashtiriladi.
• Ishlab chiqarishdagi muammolar o‘rganiladi va mummolarni yechimlari bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
Ilmiy tadqiqot faoliyati rivojlantiriladi. Ilmiy tadqiqotlar transport sohasidagi innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish uchun xizmat qiladi. Asosiy yo‘nalishlari sifatida energiya samarador transport vositalari, ekologik toza transport, avtomobil diagnostikasi tizimlari va transport logistikasini optimallashtirish kabi yo‘nalishlar kiritildi.
4-yil (2029) – Xalqaro hamkorlikni kengaytirish
Tadbirlar:
• xorijiy universitetlar bilan qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari
• akademik almashinuv dasturlari
• qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari
• xorijiy professorlarni jalb qilish
• qo‘shma ilmiy konferensiyalar o‘tkazish
• xalqaro loyihalar
• innovatsion texnopark tashkil qilish
• To‘rtinchi yilda kutilayotgan natijalar xalqaro standartlarga mos ta’lim va talabalar va o‘qituvchilarning global tajribasi
5-yil (2030) – Ta’lim sifati va barqaror rivojlanish
Tadbirlar:
• ta’lim dasturini xalqaro akkreditatsiyadan o‘tkazish
• sanoat korxonalari bilan uzoq muddatli hamkorlik
• raqamli ta’lim muhitini to‘liq joriy qilish
• o‘qituvchilarni malakasini oshirish
• ilmiy darajali kadrlar ulushini oshirish
• yosh olimlarni qo‘llab quvvatlash
• bitiruvchilarning ish bilan ta’minlanish monitoringi
Beshinchi yilda kutiladigan natijalar xalqaro tan olingan ta’lim dasturi va yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlanishiga erishiladi. Ta’lim jarayoniga raqamli texnologiyalarni joriy qilish talabalarning bilim olish imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi. Bunda onlayn ta’lim platformalarini joriy qilish; virtual laboratoriyalardan foydalanish; raqamli ta’lim resurslarini ishlab chiqish nazarda tutiladi.
Moliyaviy barqarorlik quyidagi manbalar orqali ta’minlanadi:
1)ilmiy grantlar
2)sanoat korxonalari bilan hamkorlik
3) konsalting xizmatlari
4)innovatsion ishlanmalarni tijoratlashtirish
II. Kutilgan asosiy ko‘rsatkichlar
Ko‘rsatkich	2026	2028	2030
Yangilangan fanlar soni	5	10	15
Zamonaviy laboratoriyalar	2	4	8
Scientific articles	10	25	40
International partner universities	1	2	3
Startup projects	1	2	3
III. Expected General Results
• modern engineering education
• specialists in innovative and digital transport technologies
• education integrated with industry
• training in accordance with international standards
• carrying out research in the field of transport
• expansion of international cooperation.
• Ensuring financial stability
Conclusion
The concept of development of the educational direction "Vehicle Engineering (Road Transport)" serves to train competitive, highly qualified and innovative-minded engineers for the transport sector. Research in the field will be developed. International cooperation will be expanded, innovations in the transport sector will be introduced. Innovative Transport Machinery Innovation Technopark is created. A mechanism of support for young scientists will be developed. Scientific laboratory centers of transport and mechanical engineering were established. The problems of production are explored, their solutions, practical proposals are developed, which are implemented in transport enterprises and organizations. The strategy for the development of the educational direction "Vehicle Engineering (Road Transport)" plays an important role in the modernization of the transport sector and the training of modern engineering personnel. Through the implementation of this strategy, a modern education system in the field of transport engineering will be formed, and a worthy contribution to the development of the transport network of the national economy will be made.","هاذه الاقسام ال6 ترتبط ب كلية Faculty of Service and Digitalization"]}]

Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha 5 yillik istiqbolli rivojlanish rejasi (2026–2030)
Jahon iqtisodiyotida transport tizimi muhim strategik tarmoqlardan biri hisoblanadi. Ayniqsa avtomobil transporti sohasi jadal sur’atlarda rivojlanib, yangi texnologiyalar, raqamli boshqaruv tizimlari va ekologik talablar bilan boyib bormoqda. Elektr transport vositalari, intellektual transport tizimlari, avtomatlashtirilgan boshqaruv va raqamli diagnostika kabi innovatsion texnologiyalar transport sohasini tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda. O‘zbekiston Respublikasida ham transport infratuzilmasini modernizatsiya qilish, logistika tizimini takomillashtirish va zamonaviy transport texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo‘yicha keng ko‘lamli islohotlar amalga oshirilmoqda. Bu esa transport sohasi uchun yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlashni yanada takomillashtirish zaruratini keltirib chiqaradi. “Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” ta’lim yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini rivojlantirish, ta’lim mazmunini zamonaviy talablarga moslashtirish va ilmiy tadqiqotlar salohiyatini oshirish mazkur strategiyaning asosiy vazifalaridan hisoblanadi.
Rejaning asosiy maqsadi: Oliy ta’lim muassasalarida transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) sohasi bo‘yicha zamonaviy bilim, amaliy ko‘nikma va innovatsion fikrlashga ega mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini takomillashtirish, hamda transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) ta’lim yo‘nalishini xalqaro standartlar asosida rivojlantirish, raqobatbardosh muhandis kadrlar tayyorlash tizimini shakllantirishdan iborat.
Asosiy vazifalar sifatida quyidagi mezonlar qabul qilindi.
1.ta’lim dasturlarini xalqaro standartlar asosida yangilash
2.zamonaviy laboratoriya va o‘quv bazasini rivojlantirish
3.sanoat korxonalari bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish
4.raqamli texnologiyalar va “yashil transport” yo‘nalishlarini joriy etish
5.professor-o‘qituvchilarning ilmiy salohiyatini oshirish
6.talabalarning amaliy va innovatsion faolligini kuchaytirish
7. xalqaro hamkorlik va akademik mobillikni rivojlantirish
I. 5 yillik bosqichma-bosqich rivojlanish rejasi
1-yil (2026) – Ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish
Asosiy yo‘nalishlar:
1.O‘quv rejalarini xalqaro standartlar (ABET, EUR-ACE) asosida qayta ko‘rib chiqish
2.Zamonaviy fanlarni kiritish:
A)Elektr va gibrid avtomobillar
V)Avtomobil elektronikasi
S)Intellektual transport tizimlari
D)CAD/CAE modellashtirish
3.o‘quv jarayoniga raqamli platformalarni joriy qilish
4.korxonalar bilan dual ta’lim mexanizmlarini ishlab chiqish
Ta’lim jarayonini raqamlashtirish izchil amalga oshiriladi. Raqamli texnologiyalar ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish imkonini beradi. Bunda asosiy yo‘nalishlar elektron ta’lim platformalari, virtual laboratoriyalar, transport tizimlarini modellashtirish dasturlari, hamda masofaviy ta’lim tizimi amalga oshiriladi. Birinchi yil ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish oqali yangilangan bakalavr ta’lim dasturi va sanoat talablariga mos kompetensiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
2-yil (2027) – Moddiy-texnik bazani kuchaytirish Ikkinchi yilda quyidagi tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi. Bunda yangi laboratoriyalarni tashkil etish nazarda tutilgan:
1.Avtomobil diagnostikasi laboratoriyasi
2.Elektromobillar laboratoriyasi
3.Dvigatellar sinov laboratoriyasi
4.Avtomobil elektronikasi laboratoriyasi
5.simulyator va virtual laboratoriyalar joriy etish
6.CAD/CAM/CAE dasturlari (SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) bilan ta’minlash
7.Transport modellashtirish markazi
Infratuzilmani modernizatsiya qilish
Ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish uchun zamonaviy infratuzilma zarur bo‘ladi. Ikkinchi yilda Kutilayotgan natijalar amaliyotga yo‘naltirilgan ta’limni shakllantirish va talabalarning muhandislik ko‘nikmalari oshirishdan iborat.
3-yil (2028) – Ilmiy tadqiqot va innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish
Amalga oshiriladigan tadbirlar:
• “Innovatsion transport texnologiyalari” ilmiy markazini tashkil etish
• talabalar startap loyihalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash
• ilmiy grantlar va xalqaro loyihalarda ishtirok
• ilmiy jurnallarda maqolalar sonini oshirish
Asosiy tadqiqot yo‘nalishlari: elektr transport, yoqilg‘i tejamkor dvigatellar, ekologik transport intellektual transport tizimlari Uchinchi yilda ilmiy ishlanmalar patentlar va innovatsion loyihalar amalga oshiriladi. Sanoat bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish orqali ta’lim tizimini ishlab chiqarish bilan integratsiya qilish kadrlar tayyorlash samaradorligini oshiradi. Bu borada: • transport korxonalari bilan hamkorlik shartnomalari tuzish;
• dual ta’lim tizimini joriy qilish;
• talabalarni ishlab chiqarish amaliyotlariga keng jalb qilish;
• korxona mutaxassislarini ta’lim jarayoniga jalb qilish rejalashtiriladi.
• Ishlab chiqarishdagi muammolar o‘rganiladi va mummolarni yechimlari bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
Ilmiy tadqiqot faoliyati rivojlantiriladi. Ilmiy tadqiqotlar transport sohasidagi innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish uchun xizmat qiladi. Asosiy yo‘nalishlari sifatida energiya samarador transport vositalari, ekologik toza transport, avtomobil diagnostikasi tizimlari va transport logistikasini optimallashtirish kabi yo‘nalishlar kiritildi.
4-yil (2029) – Xalqaro hamkorlikni kengaytirish
Tadbirlar:
• xorijiy universitetlar bilan qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari
• akademik almashinuv dasturlari
• qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari
• xorijiy professorlarni jalb qilish
• qo‘shma ilmiy konferensiyalar o‘tkazish

• innovatsion texnopark tashkil qilish
• To‘rtinchi yilda kutilayotgan natijalar xalqaro standartlarga mos ta’lim va talabalar va o‘qituvchilarning global tajribasi
5-yil (2030) – Ta’lim sifati va barqaror rivojlanish
Tadbirlar:
• ta’lim dasturini xalqaro akkreditatsiyadan o‘tkazish
• sanoat korxonalari bilan uzoq muddatli hamkorlik
• raqamli ta’lim muhitini to‘liq joriy qilish
• o‘qituvchilarni malakasini oshirish
• ilmiy darajali kadrlar ulushini oshirish
• yosh olimlarni qo‘llab quvvatlash
• bitiruvchilarning ish bilan ta’minlanish monitoringi
Beshinchi yilda kutiladigan natijalar xalqaro tan olingan ta’lim dasturi va yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlanishiga erishiladi. Ta’lim jarayoniga raqamli texnologiyalarni joriy qilish talabalarning bilim olish imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi. Bunda onlayn ta’lim platformalarini joriy qilish; virtual laboratoriyalardan foydalanish; raqamli ta’lim resurslarini ishlab chiqish nazarda tutiladi.
Moliyaviy barqarorlik quyidagi manbalar orqali ta’minlanadi:

Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha 5 yillik istiqbolli rivojlanish rejasi (2026–2030)
Jahon iqtisodiyotida transport tizimi muhim strategik tarmoqlardan biri hisoblanadi. Ayniqsa avtomobil transporti sohasi jadal sur’atlarda rivojlanib, yangi texnologiyalar, raqamli boshqaruv tizimlari va ekologik talablar bilan boyib bormoqda. Elektr transport vositalari, intellektual transport tizimlari, avtomatlashtirilgan boshqaruv va raqamli diagnostika kabi innovatsion texnologiyalar transport sohasini tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda. O‘zbekiston Respublikasida ham transport infratuzilmasini modernizatsiya qilish, logistika tizimini takomillashtirish va zamonaviy transport texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo‘yicha keng ko‘lamli islohotlar amalga oshirilmoqda. Bu esa transport sohasi uchun yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlashni yanada takomillashtirish zaruratini keltirib chiqaradi. “Transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti)” ta’lim yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini rivojlantirish, ta’lim mazmunini zamonaviy talablarga moslashtirish va ilmiy tadqiqotlar salohiyatini oshirish mazkur strategiyaning asosiy vazifalaridan hisoblanadi.
Rejaning asosiy maqsadi: Oliy ta’lim muassasalarida transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) sohasi bo‘yicha zamonaviy bilim, amaliy ko‘nikma va innovatsion fikrlashga ega mutaxassislar tayyorlash tizimini takomillashtirish, hamda transport vositalari muhandisligi (avtomobil transporti) ta’lim yo‘nalishini xalqaro standartlar asosida rivojlantirish, raqobatbardosh muhandis kadrlar tayyorlash tizimini shakllantirishdan iborat.
Asosiy vazifalar sifatida quyidagi mezonlar qabul qilindi.
1.ta’lim dasturlarini xalqaro standartlar asosida yangilash
2.zamonaviy laboratoriya va o‘quv bazasini rivojlantirish
3.sanoat korxonalari bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish
4.raqamli texnologiyalar va “yashil transport” yo‘nalishlarini joriy etish
5.professor-o‘qituvchilarning ilmiy salohiyatini oshirish
6.talabalarning amaliy va innovatsion faolligini kuchaytirish
7. xalqaro hamkorlik va akademik mobillikni rivojlantirish
I. 5 yillik bosqichma-bosqich rivojlanish rejasi
1-yil (2026) – Ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish
Asosiy yo‘nalishlar:
1.O‘quv rejalarini xalqaro standartlar (ABET, EUR-ACE) asosida qayta ko‘rib chiqish
2.Zamonaviy fanlarni kiritish:
A)Elektr va gibrid avtomobillar
V)Avtomobil elektronikasi
S)Intellektual transport tizimlari
D)CAD/CAE modellashtirish
3.o‘quv jarayoniga raqamli platformalarni joriy qilish
4.korxonalar bilan dual ta’lim mexanizmlarini ishlab chiqish
Ta’lim jarayonini raqamlashtirish izchil amalga oshiriladi. Raqamli texnologiyalar ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish imkonini beradi. Bunda asosiy yo‘nalishlar elektron ta’lim platformalari, virtual laboratoriyalar, transport tizimlarini modellashtirish dasturlari, hamda masofaviy ta’lim tizimi amalga oshiriladi. Birinchi yil ta’lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish oqali yangilangan bakalavr ta’lim dasturi va sanoat talablariga mos kompetensiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
2-yil (2027) – Moddiy-texnik bazani kuchaytirish Ikkinchi yilda quyidagi tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi. Bunda yangi laboratoriyalarni tashkil etish nazarda tutilgan:
1.Avtomobil diagnostikasi laboratoriyasi
2.Elektromobillar laboratoriyasi
3.Dvigatellar sinov laboratoriyasi
4.Avtomobil elektronikasi laboratoriyasi
5.simulyator va virtual laboratoriyalar joriy etish
6.CAD/CAM/CAE dasturlari (SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) bilan ta’minlash
7.Transport modellashtirish markazi
Infratuzilmani modernizatsiya qilish
Ta’lim jarayonini samarali tashkil etish uchun zamonaviy infratuzilma zarur bo‘ladi. Ikkinchi yilda Kutilayotgan natijalar amaliyotga yo‘naltirilgan ta’limni shakllantirish va talabalarning muhandislik ko‘nikmalari oshirishdan iborat.
3-yil (2028) – Ilmiy tadqiqot va innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish
Amalga oshiriladigan tadbirlar:
• “Innovatsion transport texnologiyalari” ilmiy markazini tashkil etish
• talabalar startap loyihalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash
• ilmiy grantlar va xalqaro loyihalarda ishtirok
• ilmiy jurnallarda maqolalar sonini oshirish
Asosiy tadqiqot yo‘nalishlari: elektr transport, yoqilg‘i tejamkor dvigatellar, ekologik transport intellektual transport tizimlari Uchinchi yilda ilmiy ishlanmalar patentlar va innovatsion loyihalar amalga oshiriladi. Sanoat bilan integratsiyani kuchaytirish orqali ta’lim tizimini ishlab chiqarish bilan integratsiya qilish kadrlar tayyorlash samaradorligini oshiradi. Bu borada: • transport korxonalari bilan hamkorlik shartnomalari tuzish;
• dual ta’lim tizimini joriy qilish;
• talabalarni ishlab chiqarish amaliyotlariga keng jalb qilish;
• korxona mutaxassislarini ta’lim jarayoniga jalb qilish rejalashtiriladi.
• Ishlab chiqarishdagi muammolar o‘rganiladi va mummolarni yechimlari bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqiladi.
Ilmiy tadqiqot faoliyati rivojlantiriladi. Ilmiy tadqiqotlar transport sohasidagi innovatsiyalarni rivojlantirish uchun xizmat qiladi. Asosiy yo‘nalishlari sifatida energiya samarador transport vositalari, ekologik toza transport, avtomobil diagnostikasi tizimlari va transport logistikasini optimallashtirish kabi yo‘nalishlar kiritildi.
4-yil (2029) – Xalqaro hamkorlikni kengaytirish

5-yil (2030) – Ta’lim sifati va barqaror rivojlanish
Tadbirlar:
• ta’lim dasturini xalqaro akkreditatsiyadan o‘tkazish
• sanoat korxonalari bilan uzoq muddatli hamkorlik
• raqamli ta’lim muhitini to‘liq joriy qilish
• o‘qituvchilarni malakasini oshirish
• ilmiy darajali kadrlar ulushini oshirish
• yosh olimlarni qo‘llab quvvatlash
• bitiruvchilarning ish bilan ta’minlanish monitoringi
Beshinchi yilda kutiladigan natijalar xalqaro tan olingan ta’lim dasturi va yuqori malakali muhandis kadrlar tayyorlanishiga erishiladi. Ta’lim jarayoniga raqamli texnologiyalarni joriy qilish talabalarning bilim olish imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi. Bunda onlayn ta’lim platformalarini joriy qilish; virtual laboratoriyalardan foydalanish; raqamli ta’lim resurslarini ishlab chiqish nazarda tutiladi.
Moliyaviy barqarorlik quyidagi manbalar orqali ta’minlanadi:
1)ilmiy grantlar
2)sanoat korxonalari bilan hamkorlik
3) konsalting xizmatlari
4)innovatsion ishlanmalarni tijoratlashtirish
