• modern engineering education
• specialists in innovative and digital transport technologies
• education integrated with industry
• training in accordance with international standards
• carrying out research in the field of transport
• expansion of international cooperation.
• Ensuring financial stability
Conclusion
The concept of development of the educational direction "Vehicle Engineering (Road Transport)" serves to train competitive, highly qualified and innovative-minded engineers for the transport sector. Research in the field will be developed. International cooperation will be expanded, innovations in the transport sector will be introduced. Innovative Transport Machinery Innovation Technopark is created. A mechanism of support for young scientists will be developed. Scientific laboratory centers of transport and mechanical engineering were established. The problems of production are explored, their solutions, practical proposals are developed, which are implemented in transport enterprises and organizations. The strategy for the development of the educational direction "Vehicle Engineering (Road Transport)" plays an important role in the modernization of the transport sector and the training of modern engineering personnel. Through the implementation of this strategy, a modern education system in the field of transport engineering will be formed, and a worthy contribution to the development of the transport network of the national economy will be made.","هاذه الاقسام ال6 ترتبط ب كلية Faculty of Service and Digitalization"]}]

department_translations.description:
“Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi tarixi
Kafedra 1968 yilda tashkil topgan. 1975 yilda "Falsafa", 1979 yilda “Siyosiy tarix" nomlari bilan atalgan. 1980 yil 3 ta mustaqil kafedra: "Falsafa", "Siyosiy tarix" va "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq" (Sobiq "Ilmiy kommunizm") kafedralari tashkil etildi.
1992 yildan "Falsafa", "O‘zbekiston tarixi", "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq” kafedrasi faoliyat ko‘rsatdi. 2005 yilga kelib "Falsafa", "O‘zbekiston tarixi", "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq” kafedralar birlashtirilib "Ijtimoiy fanlar" kafedrasi nomi berildi.
2011-2013 yilgacha "Tarix va falsafa" kafedrasi, 2013-2015 yilgacha "Tarix" kafedrasi, 2015 yildan “O‘zbekiston tarixi" kafedrasi nomi bilan faoliyat yuritdi. 2020 yildan qayta "Ijtimoiy fanlar" kafedrasi nomi berildi, 2024 yil 1 sentyabrda BMTI strukturasida o’zgartirish kiritilib “Jismoniy madaniyat” kafedrasi (“Jismoniy madaniyat” kafedrasi avvalgi Buxoro oziq-ovqat va yengil sanoat texnologiya instituti hozirgi Buxoro muhandislik-texnologiya instituti tarkibida 1978 yilda tashkil topgan) bilan birlashtirildi va "Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi deb nomlandi.
2025 yil 1 apreldan O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Prezidentining 2025 yil 24 yanvardagi PQ-22-son qarori bilan tashkil etilgan Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti tarkibiga "Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi nomi bilan kiritildi.

department_translations.name: Социальные науки и физическая культура
department_translations.description:
“Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi tarixi
Kafedra 1968 yilda tashkil topgan. 1975 yilda "Falsafa", 1979 yilda “Siyosiy tarix" nomlari bilan atalgan. 1980 yil 3 ta mustaqil kafedra: "Falsafa", "Siyosiy tarix" va "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq" (Sobiq "Ilmiy kommunizm") kafedralari tashkil etildi.
1992 yildan "Falsafa", "O‘zbekiston tarixi", "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq” kafedrasi faoliyat ko‘rsatdi. 2005 yilga kelib "Falsafa", "O‘zbekiston tarixi", "Siyosatshunoslik va huquq” kafedralar birlashtirilib "Ijtimoiy fanlar" kafedrasi nomi berildi.
2011-2013 yilgacha "Tarix va falsafa" kafedrasi, 2013-2015 yilgacha "Tarix" kafedrasi, 2015 yildan “O‘zbekiston tarixi" kafedrasi nomi bilan faoliyat yuritdi. 2020 yildan qayta "Ijtimoiy fanlar" kafedrasi nomi berildi, 2024 yil 1 sentyabrda BMTI strukturasida o’zgartirish kiritilib “Jismoniy madaniyat” kafedrasi (“Jismoniy madaniyat” kafedrasi avvalgi Buxoro oziq-ovqat va yengil sanoat texnologiya instituti hozirgi Buxoro muhandislik-texnologiya instituti tarkibida 1978 yilda tashkil topgan) bilan birlashtirildi va "Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi deb nomlandi.
2025 yil 1 apreldan O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Prezidentining 2025 yil 24 yanvardagi PQ-22-son qarori bilan tashkil etilgan Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti tarkibiga "Ijtimoiy fanlar va jismoniy madaniyat" kafedrasi nomi bilan kiritildi.

department_translations.description:
The department was organized in 1972 on the basis of the Bukhara branch of the former Tashkent Polytechnic Institute. The department is headed by prof. M.N.Rakhmatov, prof. M.T.Toshev, prof. S.Kh.Astanov and Ph.D. M.Z.Sharipov, Ph.D., was headed by associate professor O.S. Komilov. Currently the head of the department is Ph.D.
The Physics Division was founded on October 6, 1972 by the former Tоshkеnt Pоlitехnika Institute.

department_translations.description:
Department of Information and Communication Technologies       

Atoyev Fazliddin Sayfiddinovich
 Reception time: Dushanba-Juma (14:00-16:00 gacha)
 Phone: +998 99 380 81 88
 Email: -

History of the chair Information and Communication technologies
"Information and communication technologies" department
Since 1979 the department has been known as "Applied Mathematics" as part of the Bukhara Technological University of Food and Light Industry. In parallel with the work carried out and changes in the field of the department, the name of the department was changed in different ways over the years: "Informatics", "Informatics" (1999), "Informatics" (year 2001), "Interfaculty "Informatics" and "Modern technologies of training", which provide specialized personnel to the branches of the national economy. In 2005, both departments were renamed "Informatics and information technology", "Information technology" since September 2015 and "Information and communication technologies" since August 2017. Since 1992, the department trains qualified specialists in the specialty of "Computer Technology", then 5140900-Vocational education (Informatics and information technology), 53302000-Informatics and information technology, 60610200-Information systems and technologies (by industries and industries), currently 60610100-Information systems and technologies in the direction and 70610201 - Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries) The specialty received the status of a department. In 1985, not only in our region, but also among the universities of the Republic of Uzbekistan the electronic computer ES-1035 was put into operation. The range of disciplines at the department was widened, and the material and technical base was equipped with new modern computers. The department specializes in training masters in "Mathematical and software support of computers, complexes, systems and networks" and 70610201 – Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries). During the period 1996 – 2015, more than 3,000 leading specialists were trained at Institute-Institut of Pedagogical Sciences. The department has modern computers and teaching aids, laboratories, and multi-classrooms. In 1991-2015. 1 DSc and 25 candidates and PhD theses were defended. The main composition of the department are young people, whose average age is 42 years. At present, 3 doctoral students and 3 freelance researchers are conducting research on PhD and DCS dissertations. Their defense is scheduled for 2026-2028. For the duration of the department's activity 32 textbooks and teaching aids for professional colleges, 12 textbooks and more than 50 teaching aids for universities, published with the stamp of the Ministry of Higher Education, more than 200 author's certificates for software have been received. The department works with gifted students in different years, 8 students won state scholarships named after Beruni and Navoi, 6 students participated in the "Voice of the Future" media competition at regional and republican stages and won prizes. The teachers of the department cooperate with foreign colleagues who are winners of two international grants. Due to these grants, sufficient success was achieved in providing the material and technical base of the department and literature, and a number of teachers of the department in modern information technology were successfully trained in modern information technologies in prestigious universities in Latvia, Sweden, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Slovenia, Russia, Malaysia.

 Reception time: Dushanba-Juma (14:00-16:00 gacha)

History of the chair Information and Communication technologies
"Information and communication technologies" department
Since 1979 the department has been known as "Applied Mathematics" as part of the Bukhara Technological University of Food and Light Industry. In parallel with the work carried out and changes in the field of the department, the name of the department was changed in different ways over the years: "Informatics", "Informatics" (1999), "Informatics" (year 2001), "Interfaculty "Informatics" and "Modern technologies of training", which provide specialized personnel to the branches of the national economy. In 2005, both departments were renamed "Informatics and information technology", "Information technology" since September 2015 and "Information and communication technologies" since August 2017. Since 1992, the department trains qualified specialists in the specialty of "Computer Technology", then 5140900-Vocational education (Informatics and information technology), 53302000-Informatics and information technology, 60610200-Information systems and technologies (by industries and industries), currently 60610100-Information systems and technologies in the direction and 70610201 - Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries) The specialty received the status of a department. In 1985, not only in our region, but also among the universities of the Republic of Uzbekistan the electronic computer ES-1035 was put into operation. The range of disciplines at the department was widened, and the material and technical base was equipped with new modern computers. The department specializes in training masters in "Mathematical and software support of computers, complexes, systems and networks" and 70610201 – Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries). During the period 1996 – 2015, more than 3,000 leading specialists were trained at Institute-Institut of Pedagogical Sciences. The department has modern computers and teaching aids, laboratories, and multi-classrooms. In 1991-2015. 1 DSc and 25 candidates and PhD theses were defended. The main composition of the department are young people, whose average age is 42 years. At present, 3 doctoral students and 3 freelance researchers are conducting research on PhD and DCS dissertations. Their defense is scheduled for 2026-2028. For the duration of the department's activity 32 textbooks and teaching aids for professional colleges, 12 textbooks and more than 50 teaching aids for universities, published with the stamp of the Ministry of Higher Education, more than 200 author's certificates for software have been received. The department works with gifted students in different years, 8 students won state scholarships named after Beruni and Navoi, 6 students participated in the "Voice of the Future" media competition at regional and republican stages and won prizes. The teachers of the department cooperate with foreign colleagues who are winners of two international grants. Due to these grants, sufficient success was achieved in providing the material and technical base of the department and literature, and a number of teachers of the department in modern information technology were successfully trained in modern information technologies in prestigious universities in Latvia, Sweden, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Slovenia, Russia, Malaysia.

Department of Information and Communication Technologies       

Atoyev Fazliddin Sayfiddinovich
 Reception time: Dushanba-Juma (14:00-16:00 gacha)
 Phone: +998 99 380 81 88
 Email: -

History of the chair Information and Communication technologies
"Information and communication technologies" department
Since 1979 the department has been known as "Applied Mathematics" as part of the Bukhara Technological University of Food and Light Industry. In parallel with the work carried out and changes in the field of the department, the name of the department was changed in different ways over the years: "Informatics", "Informatics" (1999), "Informatics" (year 2001), "Interfaculty "Informatics" and "Modern technologies of training", which provide specialized personnel to the branches of the national economy. In 2005, both departments were renamed "Informatics and information technology", "Information technology" since September 2015 and "Information and communication technologies" since August 2017. Since 1992, the department trains qualified specialists in the specialty of "Computer Technology", then 5140900-Vocational education (Informatics and information technology), 53302000-Informatics and information technology, 60610200-Information systems and technologies (by industries and industries), currently 60610100-Information systems and technologies in the direction and 70610201 - Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries) The specialty received the status of a department. In 1985, not only in our region, but also among the universities of the Republic of Uzbekistan the electronic computer ES-1035 was put into operation. The range of disciplines at the department was widened, and the material and technical base was equipped with new modern computers. The department specializes in training masters in "Mathematical and software support of computers, complexes, systems and networks" and 70610201 – Computer systems and its software (by industries and industries). During the period 1996 – 2015, more than 3,000 leading specialists were trained at Institute-Institut of Pedagogical Sciences. The department has modern computers and teaching aids, laboratories, and multi-classrooms. In 1991-2015. 1 DSc and 25 candidates and PhD theses were defended. The main composition of the department are young people, whose average age is 42 years. At present, 3 doctoral students and 3 freelance researchers are conducting research on PhD and DCS dissertations. Their defense is scheduled for 2026-2028. For the duration of the department's activity 32 textbooks and teaching aids for professional colleges, 12 textbooks and more than 50 teaching aids for universities, published with the stamp of the Ministry of Higher Education, more than 200 author's certificates for software have been received. The department works with gifted students in different years, 8 students won state scholarships named after Beruni and Navoi, 6 students participated in the "Voice of the Future" media competition at regional and republican stages and won prizes. The teachers of the department cooperate with foreign colleagues who are winners of two international grants. Due to these grants, sufficient success was achieved in providing the material and technical base of the department and literature, and a number of teachers of the department in modern information technology were successfully trained in modern information technologies in prestigious universities in Latvia, Sweden, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Slovenia, Russia, Malaysia.

department_translations.description:
In many ways, the important factor in the sustainable development of the national economy, the growth of production rates in its industries, and the increase of the international competitiveness of the country are provided by personnel trained in economic areas. The departments of economics established at the Institute make a great contribution to their upbringing of qualified specialists.
The history and development of these departments dates back to the second half of the 20th century. For the first time, the Department of Economics was founded at the General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute on September 1, 1969. By September 1, 1978, it began to work at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry under the name of the more improved department of "Political economy".

department_translations.name: Department of Economics and Management
department_translations.description:
In many ways, the important factor in the sustainable development of the national economy, the growth of production rates in its industries, and the increase of the international competitiveness of the country are provided by personnel trained in economic areas. The departments of economics established at the Institute make a great contribution to their upbringing of qualified specialists.
The history and development of these departments dates back to the second half of the 20th century. For the first time, the Department of Economics was founded at the General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute on September 1, 1969. By September 1, 1978, it began to work at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry under the name of the more improved department of "Political economy".

The departments of economics established at the Institute make a great contribution to their upbringing of qualified specialists.
The history and development of these departments dates back to the second half of the 20th century. For the first time, the Department of Economics was founded at the General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute on September 1, 1969. By September 1, 1978, it began to work at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry under the name of the more improved department of "Political economy".","The Department "Production and Management" was organized in 1993 on the basis of the department "Economy, organization and planning of production". The main task of the department is providing economic knowledge and research work in these areas to food enterprises. In 1997, the department was named "Theory of economics and marketing", associate professor O.M.Hamrokulov (deceased). At the beginning of the 1998-1999 academic year "Economics" and "Marketing" departments began to work separately. Associate professor Abdullayeva Z.M. was appointed head of the Department of Economics, and associate professor O.M. Hamrokulov was appointed head of the Department of Marketing.
On December 29, 2001, "Economics" and "Marketing" departments were merged to "Marketing and Economics", and since September 2003 "Marketing". Since 2010, the department "Marketing" was headed by associate professor B.F. Azimov, "Management" was headed by associate professor Ruzieva D.I., from 2018 to 2022, PhD in economics Khaitov Sh.N.
Since April 15, 2013 in accordance with the Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan "Decree No. 1954" on the establishment of the Bukhara Engineering and Technological Institute, the department was renamed into the Department of Management and continued its work until September 15, 2021. In accordance with the order of the rector of the Bukhara Engineering Technological Institute No. 499-U dated September 15, 2021, the department of "Economics" was separated from the department "Management" and began to work as a separate department. Since 2021, the Department of Economics has been headed by Associate Professor Boboev A.Ch., the Department of Management is Associate Professor Zayavitdinova N.M., Associate Professor (PhD) Avezova Sh.M. department_translations.description:
In many ways, the important factor in the sustainable development of the national economy, the growth of production rates in its industries, and the increase of the international competitiveness of the country are provided by personnel trained in economic areas. The departments of economics established at the Institute make a great contribution to their upbringing of qualified specialists.
The history and development of these departments dates back to the second half of the 20th century. For the first time, the Department of Economics was founded at the General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute on September 1, 1969. By September 1, 1978, it began to work at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry under the name of the more improved department of "Political economy".

department_translations.name: Electrical and Power Engineering
department_translations.description:
The Department of Electrical Power Engineering was established in 1977 by the order of the rector of the institute under the leadership of M. T. Turdiev. It was separated from the Department of General Technical Sciences and initially named "General Electrical Engineering."

Since 1978, the department has been training part-time students in the field of "Power Supply of Industrial Enterprises, Cities, and Agriculture." In 1985, it began training full-time students in the field of "Electrical Power Engineering." Since 1998, it has been preparing specialists in "Electrical Power Engineering," and since 2000, it has been admitting master's students in the specialty "Power Supply (by sectors)."

The department has been headed by: M. T. Turdiev (1977-1985, 1994-2005), A. M. Abdullaev (1985-1994), N. N. Sadullaev (2005-2011), M. I. Makhmudov (2011-2018), and I. I. Khafizov (2018-2019).

In the 2024-2025 academic year, as a result of internal structural changes at the university, the Department of "Electrical Power Engineering and Electrical Engineering" was formed based on three departments. In the same academic year, N. N. Mirzaev served as the head of the department. Since the beginning of the 2025-2026 academic year, the department has been headed by Associate Professor Latipov Saidmurod Tuyg'unovich.

Currently, the department employs 3 professors, 23 associate professors, 7 senior lecturers, 9 assistants, and 9 trainee teachers.

department_translations.description:
The Department of Electrical Power Engineering was established in 1977 by the order of the rector of the institute under the leadership of M. T. Turdiev. It was separated from the Department of General Technical Sciences and initially named "General Electrical Engineering."

Since 1978, the department has been training part-time students in the field of "Power Supply of Industrial Enterprises, Cities, and Agriculture." In 1985, it began training full-time students in the field of "Electrical Power Engineering." Since 1998, it has been preparing specialists in "Electrical Power Engineering," and since 2000, it has been admitting master's students in the specialty "Power Supply (by sectors)."

The department has been headed by: M. T. Turdiev (1977-1985, 1994-2005), A. M. Abdullaev (1985-1994), N. N. Sadullaev (2005-2011), M. I. Makhmudov (2011-2018), and I. I. Khafizov (2018-2019).

In the 2024-2025 academic year, as a result of internal structural changes at the university, the Department of "Electrical Power Engineering and Electrical Engineering" was formed based on three departments. In the same academic year, N. N. Mirzaev served as the head of the department. Since the beginning of the 2025-2026 academic year, the department has been headed by Associate Professor Latipov Saidmurod Tuyg'unovich.

Currently, the department employs 3 professors, 23 associate professors, 7 senior lecturers, 9 assistants, and 9 trainee teachers.

department_translations.name: Architecture
department_translations.description:
The First President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, I. A. Karimov, during his visit to the Bukhara region on July 13-14, 2007, while inspecting construction works in the city of Bukhara, emphasized that the city has a very ancient history and, accordingly, should have its own unique architectural identity. He stressed the importance of thoroughly studying cultural heritage sites and taking into account national traditions and local conditions in the design and construction of buildings and structures.

In April 2008, during another visit to the Bukhara region, the President issued instructions to establish the training of qualified specialists directly in Bukhara, capable of understanding, preserving, and developing national architectural heritage, as well as designing modern buildings consistent with these traditions.

In implementation of these instructions, the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan issued Order No. 120 dated May 2, 2008, "On the establishment of the Faculty of Architecture and Construction at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology," and later Order No. 242 dated August 12, 2008, "On the development of the Faculty of Architecture and Construction of the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology."

Based on these orders, the Faculty of "Architecture and Construction" was established within the institute, and the educational program "Architecture" was opened. Since the 2008-2009 academic year, student admissions have been carried out for this program.

According to the decision of the extended meeting of the Academic Council of the institute No. 1 dated August 29, 2009, the Department of "Architecture" was established within the Faculty of Architecture and Construction, and the Architecture program was assigned to this department.

Currently, the department employs 20 academic staff members, including 1 Doctor of Sciences and Professor, 4 Candidates of Sciences and Associate Professors, 5 Senior Lecturers, and 3 Assistants. The department is responsible for 2 educational programs and 34 academic disciplines.

department_translations.name: Архитектура
department_translations.description:
The First President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, I. A. Karimov, during his visit to the Bukhara region on July 13-14, 2007, while inspecting construction works in the city of Bukhara, emphasized that the city has a very ancient history and, accordingly, should have its own unique architectural identity. He stressed the importance of thoroughly studying cultural heritage sites and taking into account national traditions and local conditions in the design and construction of buildings and structures.

In April 2008, during another visit to the Bukhara region, the President issued instructions to establish the training of qualified specialists directly in Bukhara, capable of understanding, preserving, and developing national architectural heritage, as well as designing modern buildings consistent with these traditions.

In implementation of these instructions, the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan issued Order No. 120 dated May 2, 2008, "On the establishment of the Faculty of Architecture and Construction at the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology," and later Order No. 242 dated August 12, 2008, "On the development of the Faculty of Architecture and Construction of the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology."

Based on these orders, the Faculty of "Architecture and Construction" was established within the institute, and the educational program "Architecture" was opened. Since the 2008-2009 academic year, student admissions have been carried out for this program.

According to the decision of the extended meeting of the Academic Council of the institute No. 1 dated August 29, 2009, the Department of "Architecture" was established within the Faculty of Architecture and Construction, and the Architecture program was assigned to this department.

Currently, the department employs 20 academic staff members, including 1 Doctor of Sciences and Professor, 4 Candidates of Sciences and Associate Professors, 5 Senior Lecturers, and 3 Assistants. The department is responsible for 2 educational programs and 34 academic disciplines.

department_translations.name: Civil Engineering
department_translations.description:
The Department of Civil Engineering is one of the oldest departments and has been operating since 1962 as a core department of the Bukhara General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute. Throughout its long history, more than 40 highly qualified professors and associate professors have contributed significantly to the training of skilled specialists.

Currently, the department employs 32 faculty members, including 2 Doctors of Science and Professors, 15 Candidates of Science and Associate Professors, and 15 Senior Lecturers and Assistants. The scientific potential of the department is 53%.

At present, 65 academic courses are taught at the department. Currently, 654 full-time students and 758 part-time students are studying at the department.

department_translations.description:
The Department of Civil Engineering is one of the oldest departments and has been operating since 1962 as a core department of the Bukhara General Technical Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute. Throughout its long history, more than 40 highly qualified professors and associate professors have contributed significantly to the training of skilled specialists.

Currently, the department employs 32 faculty members, including 2 Doctors of Science and Professors, 15 Candidates of Science and Associate Professors, and 15 Senior Lecturers and Assistants. The scientific potential of the department is 53%.

At present, 65 academic courses are taught at the department. Currently, 654 full-time students and 758 part-time students are studying at the department.

department_translations.name: Light Industry Engineering and Design
department_translations.description:
According to Order No. U-564 issued by the Rector of Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute on September 5, 2024, the departments of "Innovative Technologies of the Garment Industry," "Technology and Design of Leather Products," and "Technology of Textile Products" were merged to establish the Department of "Light Industry Engineering and Design."

The training of engineering technologists in this field has been carried out since 1979 on the basis of the Department of "Spinning of Natural and Chemical Fibers" and since 1982 on the basis of the Department of "Technology and Equipment of Light Industry." Students have been admitted to full-time, evening, and part-time programs in these specialties. Currently, the department is headed by Doctor of Technical Sciences, Associate Professor F. F. Qazoqov.

The department employs 3 Doctors of Science (Professors), 2 Candidates of Science (Professors), 7 Candidates of Science (Associate Professors), 27 Doctors of Philosophy (PhD) (Associate Professors), 1 Associate Professor, 7 Senior Lecturers, and 15 Assistant Lecturers who provide instruction to students. The Department of Light Industry Engineering and Design organizes educational programs for bachelor degree fields and master degree specialties.

department_translations.name: هندسة وتصميم الصناعات الخفيفة
department_translations.description:
According to Order No. U-564 issued by the Rector of Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute on September 5, 2024, the departments of "Innovative Technologies of the Garment Industry," "Technology and Design of Leather Products," and "Technology of Textile Products" were merged to establish the Department of "Light Industry Engineering and Design."

The training of engineering technologists in this field has been carried out since 1979 on the basis of the Department of "Spinning of Natural and Chemical Fibers" and since 1982 on the basis of the Department of "Technology and Equipment of Light Industry." Students have been admitted to full-time, evening, and part-time programs in these specialties. Currently, the department is headed by Doctor of Technical Sciences, Associate Professor F. F. Qazoqov.

The department employs 3 Doctors of Science (Professors), 2 Candidates of Science (Professors), 7 Candidates of Science (Associate Professors), 27 Doctors of Philosophy (PhD) (Associate Professors), 1 Associate Professor, 7 Senior Lecturers, and 15 Assistant Lecturers who provide instruction to students. The Department of Light Industry Engineering and Design organizes educational programs for bachelor degree fields and master degree specialties.

department_translations.name: Mechanics and Engineering Graphics
department_translations.description:
The Department of Fundamentals of Mechanics was established on December 8, 1970, as part of the Bukhara Evening Branch of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute. In accordance with Resolution No. PQ-1533 of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated May 20, 2011, "On Measures to Strengthen the Material and Technical Base of Higher Educational Institutions and Fundamentally Improve the Quality of Training Highly Qualified Specialists," the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology was transformed into the Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute of High Technologies.

Due to changes in the organizational structure of the institute, by Rector's Order No. 84-U dated August 28, 2011, the department was renamed "Mechanics," and since September 20, 2021, it has been known as the Department of Fundamentals of Mechanics.

Currently, the department employs 13 faculty members and 2 technical staff members, including 7 professors and instructors holding academic degrees and titles. The scientific potential of the department is 50%.

department_translations.name: Technological Machines and Equipment
department_translations.description: In accordance with Resolution No. PQ-22 of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan dated January 24, 2025, "On the Establishment of Bukhara State Technical University," Bukhara State Technical University was established on the basis of the Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute and the Bukhara Institute of Natural Resources Management. From April 1, 2025, pursuant to Order No. 9-Sh dated April 2, 2025, issued by the Acting Rector of Bukhara State Technical University, the Department of "Technological Machines and Equipment" was reorganized. Special attention is paid within the department to the implementation of an innovative education system, ensuring close integration of education with industry, and promoting advanced scientific research and innovative production projects. The department currently employs 4 Doctors of Science, 23 Candidates of Technical Sciences and PhD holders, 2 Senior Lecturers, 5 Assistants, 12 Trainee Lecturers, and 17 Doctoral Researchers who are actively engaged in scientific research activities.

news_translations.title: Day of Memory and Honor!
news_translations.summary: BSTU participated in regional remembrance events dedicated to May 9, honoring the memory, courage, and sacrifice of those who defended peace and the homeland.
news_translations.content:
On the occasion of May 9, the Day of Memory and Honor, and the 81st anniversary of the Great Victory in World War II, commemorative and tribute events were organized across the Bukhara region at a high level.

Early in the morning, under the leadership of regional governor and military-administrative sector head Botir Zaripov, deputy governors, leaders of state and public organizations, labor veterans, military personnel, and young people gathered at Memory Square in the city of Bukhara.

During the event, the memory of ancestors who sacrificed their lives for the prosperity of the Motherland and the peace of the country was honored, and tribute was paid to their courage and resilience.

The team of Bukhara State Technical University also actively participated in the event, expressing deep respect for the history of our country and for the values of peace and tranquility.
news_translations.meta_description: BSTU participated in regional remembrance events dedicated to May 9, honoring the memory, courage, and sacrifice of those who defended peace and the homeland.

news_translations.title: Xotira va qadrlash kuni!
news_translations.summary: BuxDTU jamoasi 9-may sanasiga bag'ishlangan hududiy xotira tadbirlarida qatnashib, Vatan tinchligi va osoyishtaligi yo'lida fidokorlik ko'rsatgan ajdodlar xotirasiga hurmat bajo keltirdi.
news_translations.content:
9-may — Xotira va qadrlash kuni hamda Ikkinchi jahon urushidagi Buyuk g'alabaning 81 yilligi munosabati bilan Buxoro viloyatida xotira va ehtirom tadbirlari yuqori saviyada tashkil etildi.

Tong sahardan viloyat hokimi va harbiy-ma'muriy sektor rahbari Botir Zaripov boshchiligida viloyat hokimi o'rinbosarlari, davlat va jamoat tashkilotlari rahbarlari, mehnat faxriylari, harbiy xizmatchilar hamda yoshlar Buxoro shahridagi Xotira maydoniga jam bo'ldilar.

Tadbir davomida Vatan ravnaqi va yurt tinchligi yo'lida jon fido qilgan ajdodlar xotirasi yod etilib, ularning matonati va jasoratiga yuksak ehtirom ko'rsatildi.

Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti jamoasi ham ushbu tadbirda faol qatnashib, mamlakatimiz tarixi hamda tinchlik va osoyishtalik qadriyatlariga chuqur hurmatini namoyon etdi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTU jamoasi 9-may sanasiga bag'ishlangan hududiy xotira tadbirlarida qatnashib, Vatan tinchligi va osoyishtaligi yo'lida fidokorlik ko'rsatgan ajdodlar xotirasiga hurmat bajo keltirdi.

news_translations.title: День памяти и почестей!
news_translations.summary: Команда БГТУ приняла участие в региональных памятных мероприятиях, посвящённых 9 мая, отдав дань уважения памяти, мужеству и подвигу тех, кто защищал мир и Родину.
news_translations.content:
По случаю 9 мая — Дня памяти и почестей, а также 81-й годовщины Великой Победы во Второй мировой войне, в Бухарской области на высоком уровне были организованы памятные и торжественные мероприятия.

Ранним утром под руководством хокима области и руководителя военно-административного сектора Ботира Зарипова на площади Памяти в городе Бухаре собрались заместители хокима, руководители государственных и общественных организаций, ветераны труда, военнослужащие и молодёжь.

В ходе мероприятия была почтена память предков, отдавших свои жизни за процветание Родины и мир в стране, а также выражено глубокое уважение их мужеству и стойкости.

Коллектив Бухарского государственного технического университета также активно принял участие в мероприятии, продемонстрировав глубокое уважение к истории нашей страны и к ценностям мира и спокойствия.
news_translations.meta_description: Команда БГТУ приняла участие в региональных памятных мероприятиях, посвящённых 9 мая, отдав дань уважения памяти, мужеству и подвигу тех, кто защищал мир и Родину.

news_translations.title: يوم الذكرى والتقدير!
news_translations.summary: شاركت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية في فعاليات إحياء الذكرى الخاصة بيوم 9 مايو، تكريماً لذاكرة وشجاعة وتضحيات من دافعوا عن السلام والوطن.
news_translations.content:
بمناسبة التاسع من مايو، يوم الذكرى والتقدير، والذكرى الحادية والثمانين للنصر العظيم في الحرب العالمية الثانية، نُظمت في ولاية بخارى فعاليات إحياء ووفاء على مستوى عالٍ.

في ساعات الصباح الأولى، وتحت قيادة حاكم الولاية ورئيس القطاع العسكري والإداري بوتير زاريبوف، تجمع في ساحة الذكرى بمدينة بخارى نواب الحاكم، ورؤساء الهيئات الحكومية والمجتمعية، وقدامى العاملين، والعسكريون، والشباب.

وخلال الفعالية، تم إحياء ذكرى الأجداد الذين ضحوا بأرواحهم من أجل ازدهار الوطن وسلام البلاد، كما جرى التعبير عن التقدير لشجاعتهم وصلابتهم.

كما شارك فريق جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية بفاعلية في هذه المناسبة، معبراً عن احترام عميق لتاريخ بلادنا ولمعاني السلام والطمأنينة.
news_translations.meta_description: شاركت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية في فعاليات إحياء الذكرى الخاصة بيوم 9 مايو، تكريماً لذاكرة وشجاعة وتضحيات من دافعوا عن السلام والوطن.

news_translations.title: Music Therapy at the Inclusive Education Center!
news_translations.summary: A music therapy session at BSTU's Inclusive Education Center supported young participants through melody, creativity, and a warm atmosphere focused on emotional well-being.
news_translations.content:
At Bukhara State Technical University, a music therapy session was held for young people at the Inclusive Education Center.

The event was conducted by master's students of the Faculty of Music Education at Bukhara State Pedagogical Institute. Through melodies and songs, participants received positive emotions, while special attention was given to improving their emotional well-being and developing their creative abilities.

The program helped strengthen young people's interest in art, offered meaningful social support, and contributed to organizing their leisure time in a beneficial way.

The music therapy session created an uplifting mood among the participants and was held in a warm and sincere atmosphere.
news_translations.meta_title: Music Therapy at the Inclusive Education Center!
news_translations.meta_description: A music therapy session at BSTU's Inclusive Education Center supported young participants through melody, creativity, and a warm atmosphere focused on emotional well-being.

news_translations.title: Inklyuziv ta'lim markazidagi musiqaterapiya!
news_translations.summary: BuxDTUning Inklyuziv ta'lim markazida o'tkazilgan musiqaterapiya mashg'uloti yosh ishtirokchilarni kuy-qo'shiq, ijodkorlik va samimiy muhit orqali ruhiy jihatdan qo'llab-quvvatladi.
news_translations.content:
Buxoro davlat texnika universitetining Inklyuziv ta'lim markazida yoshlar uchun musiqaterapiya mashg'uloti o'tkazildi.

Tadbir Buxoro davlat pedagogika instituti Musiqa ta'limi fakulteti magistrantlari tomonidan olib borildi. Kuy va qo'shiqlar orqali ishtirokchilarga ijobiy hissiyotlar ulashilib, ularning ruhiy holatini yaxshilash va ijodiy qobiliyatlarini rivojlantirishga alohida e'tibor qaratildi.

Mazkur dastur yoshlarning san'atga qiziqishini oshirishga, ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlashni kuchaytirishga hamda bo'sh vaqtlarini mazmunli tashkil etishga xizmat qildi.

Musiqaterapiya mashg'uloti ishtirokchilarda ko'tarinki kayfiyat uyg'otib, iliq va samimiy muhitda o'tdi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTUning Inklyuziv ta'lim markazida o'tkazilgan musiqaterapiya mashg'uloti yosh ishtirokchilarni kuy-qo'shiq, ijodkorlik va samimiy muhit orqali ruhiy jihatdan qo'llab-quvvatladi.

news_translations.title: Музыкотерапия в Центре инклюзивного образования!
news_translations.summary: Сеанс музыкотерапии в Центре инклюзивного образования БГТУ поддержал молодых участников через мелодию, творчество и тёплую атмосферу, направленную на эмоциональное благополучие.
news_translations.content:
В Бухарском государственном техническом университете для молодых людей в Центре инклюзивного образования был организован сеанс музыкотерапии.

Мероприятие провели магистранты факультета музыкального образования Бухарского государственного педагогического института. С помощью мелодий и песен участникам подарили положительные эмоции, а особое внимание было уделено улучшению их эмоционального состояния и развитию творческих способностей.

Программа способствовала повышению интереса молодёжи к искусству, оказанию социальной поддержки и содержательной организации свободного времени.

Сеанс музыкотерапии создал у участников приподнятое настроение и прошёл в тёплой и искренней атмосфере.
news_translations.meta_description: Сеанс музыкотерапии в Центре инклюзивного образования БГТУ поддержал молодых участников через мелодию, творчество и тёплую атмосферу, направленную на эмоциональное благополучие.

news_translations.title: العلاج بالموسيقى في مركز التعليم الدامج!
news_translations.summary: قدمت جلسة العلاج بالموسيقى في مركز التعليم الدامج بجامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية دعمًا نفسيًا للشباب المشاركين عبر الألحان والإبداع وأجواء دافئة ركزت على الرفاه العاطفي.
news_translations.content:
أقيمت في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية جلسة علاج بالموسيقى للشباب في مركز التعليم الدامج.

أدار الفعالية طلبة الماجستير من كلية التربية الموسيقية في معهد بخارى التربوي الحكومي. ومن خلال الألحان والأغاني، حصل المشاركون على مشاعر إيجابية، مع تركيز خاص على تحسين حالتهم العاطفية وتنمية قدراتهم الإبداعية.

ساهم البرنامج في زيادة اهتمام الشباب بالفن، وتقديم الدعم الاجتماعي لهم، وتنظيم أوقات فراغهم بصورة هادفة ونافعة.

وأوجدت جلسة العلاج بالموسيقى أجواءً مبهجة بين المشاركين، وأُقيمت في بيئة دافئة وصادقة.
news_translations.meta_title: العلاج بالموسيقى في مركز التعليم الدامج!
news_translations.meta_description: قدمت جلسة العلاج بالموسيقى في مركز التعليم الدامج بجامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية دعمًا نفسيًا للشباب المشاركين عبر الألحان والإبداع وأجواء دافئة ركزت على الرفاه العاطفي.

news_translations.title: Leader and Youth Meeting!
news_translations.summary: BSTU hosted an open dialogue bringing together youth support stakeholders and students to discuss innovation, startups, and scientific potential.
news_translations.content:
At Bukhara State Technical University, an open dialogue was organized within the framework of the Leader and Youth meeting with the participation of young people supported through the Ko'mak project, heads of educational centers, publishing houses and bookstores, as well as graduates of the El-Yurt Umidi Foundation.

The meeting focused on supporting young people's innovative thinking, scientific potential, and startup initiatives.

During the event, active and initiative-driven students presented innovative projects and promising startup ideas developed on the basis of modern technologies.

Participants exchanged views on their ideas, initiatives, and future plans with university leaders, while particular attention was given to supporting innovative projects, developing startups, and creating broad opportunities for youth research.
news_translations.meta_description: BSTU hosted an open dialogue bringing together youth support stakeholders and students to discuss innovation, startups, and scientific potential.

news_translations.title: Rahbar va yoshlar uchrashuvi!
news_translations.summary: BuxDTUda yoshlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, startap tashabbuslari va ilmiy salohiyatni rivojlantirishga bag'ishlangan ochiq muloqot o'tkazildi.
news_translations.content:
Buxoro davlat texnika universitetida 'Rahbar va yoshlar' uchrashuvi doirasida Ko'mak loyihasi orqali qo'llab-quvvatlangan yoshlar, o'quv markazlari, nashriyot va kitob do'konlari rahbarlari hamda El-Yurt Umidi jamg'armasi bitiruvchilari ishtirokida ochiq muloqot tashkil etildi.

Uchrashuvda yoshlarning innovatsion fikrlashi, ilmiy salohiyati va startap tashabbuslarini qo'llab-quvvatlash masalalariga alohida e'tibor qaratildi.

Faol va tashabbuskor talabalar zamonaviy texnologiyalar asosida ishlab chiqilgan innovatsion loyihalar hamda istiqbolli startap g'oyalarini taqdim etdilar.

Muloqot davomida ishtirokchilar o'z rejalari va tashabbuslari yuzasidan universitet rahbarlari bilan fikr almashib, ilmiy izlanishlar va startaplarni qo'llab-quvvatlash bo'yicha keng imkoniyatlar muhokama qilindi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTUda yoshlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, startap tashabbuslari va ilmiy salohiyatni rivojlantirishga bag'ishlangan ochiq muloqot o'tkazildi.

news_translations.title: Встреча «Руководитель и молодёжь»!
news_translations.summary: В БГТУ состоялся открытый диалог, посвящённый поддержке молодёжи, стартап-инициатив и развитию научного потенциала.
news_translations.content:
В Бухарском государственном техническом университете в рамках встречи «Руководитель и молодёжь» был организован открытый диалог с участием молодых людей, получивших поддержку по проекту Ko'mak, руководителей образовательных центров, издательств и книжных магазинов, а также выпускников фонда El-Yurt Umidi.

Особое внимание на встрече было уделено поддержке инновационного мышления молодёжи, её научного потенциала и стартап-инициатив.

Активные и инициативные студенты представили инновационные проекты и перспективные стартап-идеи, разработанные на основе современных технологий.

В ходе диалога участники обсудили свои идеи, инициативы и планы с руководством университета, а также вопросы расширения возможностей для научной деятельности и развития стартапов.
news_translations.meta_description: В БГТУ состоялся открытый диалог, посвящённый поддержке молодёжи, стартап-инициатив и развитию научного потенциала.

news_translations.title: لقاء القائد والشباب!
news_translations.summary: استضافت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية حوارًا مفتوحًا حول دعم الشباب ومبادرات الشركات الناشئة وتنمية القدرات العلمية والابتكارية.
news_translations.content:
نُظم في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية حوار مفتوح ضمن لقاء «القائد والشباب» بمشاركة شباب مدعومين عبر مشروع Ko'mak، ومديري مراكز تعليمية، ودور نشر ومكتبات، إلى جانب خريجي مؤسسة El-Yurt Umidi.

ركز اللقاء على دعم التفكير الابتكاري لدى الشباب، وتنمية إمكاناتهم العلمية، وتعزيز مبادراتهم الريادية والشركات الناشئة.

وقدّم الطلبة النشطون والمبادرون مشروعات ابتكارية وأفكارًا واعدة لبرامج ناشئة مبنية على تقنيات حديثة.

وخلال الحوار تبادل المشاركون الآراء مع قيادة الجامعة حول أفكارهم وخططهم المستقبلية، مع اهتمام خاص بتوسيع الفرص أمام البحث العلمي وتطوير المشاريع الريادية.
news_translations.meta_description: استضافت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية حوارًا مفتوحًا حول دعم الشباب ومبادرات الشركات الناشئة وتنمية القدرات العلمية والابتكارية.

news_translations.title: “Admirers of Poetry”
news_translations.summary: BSTU students earned top honors at the regional final of the Poetry Enthusiasts competition held at the Ancient and Eternal Bukhara complex.
news_translations.content:
At the magnificent amphitheater within the Ancient and Eternal Bukhara complex, a ceremonial award event was held for the winners of the regional final stage of the Poetry Enthusiasts competition.

Students of Bukhara State Technical University achieved notable results in several categories, including works devoted to the Motherland, syllabic meter performance, aruz poetry, and monologue recitation.

Their success reflected not only literary skill but also strong spiritual values and artistic discipline.

The university community warmly congratulated the students, recognizing their achievements as a source of pride for BSTU.
news_translations.meta_description: BSTU students earned top honors at the regional final of the Poetry Enthusiasts competition held at the Ancient and Eternal Bukhara complex.

news_translations.title: She'riyat shaydolari
news_translations.summary: BuxDTU talabalari 'She'riyat shaydolari' tanlovining hududiy bosqichida yuqori natijalarga erishib, universitet sharafini munosib himoya qildilar.
news_translations.content:
Ko'hna va boqiy Buxoro majmuasidagi muhtasham amfiteatrda tanlovning final hududiy bosqichi g'oliblarini taqdirlash marosimi bo'lib o'tdi.

Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti talabalari Vatanga sadoqat, barmoq vazni, aruz yo'nalishi hamda monolog ijrosi kabi yo'nalishlarda munosib ishtirok etib, yuqori o'rinlarni egalladilar.

Mazkur natijalar talabalarning ijodiy salohiyati, ma'naviy dunyosi va adabiyotga bo'lgan hurmatini yana bir bor namoyish etdi.

Universitet jamoasi ushbu yutuqlar bilan faxrlanib, talabalarning kelgusidagi ijodiy izlanishlariga muvaffaqiyat tiladi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTU talabalari 'She'riyat shaydolari' tanlovining hududiy bosqichida yuqori natijalarga erishib, universitet sharafini munosib himoya qildilar.

news_translations.title: Поклонники поэзии
news_translations.summary: Студенты БГТУ добились высоких результатов на региональном этапе конкурса «Поклонники поэзии» и достойно представили университет.
news_translations.content:
В величественном амфитеатре комплекса «Древняя и вечная Бухара» состоялась церемония награждения победителей регионального финального этапа конкурса.

Студенты Бухарского государственного технического университета заняли призовые места в номинациях, посвящённых любви к Родине, силлабическому размеру, арузу и художественному чтению монолога.

Эти результаты наглядно показали творческий потенциал студентов, их духовную зрелость и уважение к литературе.

Коллектив университета поздравил участников с успехом и отметил их достижения как предмет общей гордости БГТУ.
news_translations.meta_description: Студенты БГТУ добились высоких результатов на региональном этапе конкурса «Поклонники поэзии» и достойно представили университет.

news_translations.title: عشاق الشعر
news_translations.summary: حقق طلاب جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية نتائج متميزة في المرحلة الإقليمية النهائية من مسابقة «عشاق الشعر» ومثلوا جامعتهم باقتدار.
news_translations.content:
في المدرج الفخم داخل مجمع «بخارى القديمة والأبدية» أُقيم حفل تكريم للفائزين في المرحلة الإقليمية النهائية من المسابقة.

أحرز طلاب جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية مراكز متقدمة في فئات متعددة شملت القصائد الوطنية، والأوزان المقطعية، والعروض، والأداء المنولوجي.

وأكدت هذه النتائج ما يتمتع به الطلبة من طاقات إبداعية وقيم روحية رفيعة واحترام عميق للأدب.

وأعربت أسرة الجامعة عن فخرها بإنجازات الطلبة، معتبرة نجاحهم مصدر اعتزاز للمجتمع الجامعي بأكمله.
news_translations.meta_description: حقق طلاب جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية نتائج متميزة في المرحلة الإقليمية النهائية من مسابقة «عشاق الشعر» ومثلوا جامعتهم باقتدار.

news_translations.title: Meeting between Leadership and Youth!
news_translations.summary: A BSTU dialogue session addressed cybersecurity, road safety, and the moral development of students with participation from university and regional officials.
news_translations.content:
At Bukhara State Technical University, a Leader and Youth meeting was held with the participation of officials from the regional internal affairs and road traffic safety structures, as well as university leadership responsible for youth affairs.

During the meeting, an open dialogue with students addressed important issues related to cybersecurity, road safety, and strengthening the moral and spiritual development of young people.

Participants had the opportunity to ask questions directly and receive practical recommendations from experienced specialists.

The session reinforced BSTU's focus on creating a safe, informed, and socially responsible student environment.
news_translations.meta_description: A BSTU dialogue session addressed cybersecurity, road safety, and the moral development of students with participation from university and regional officials.

news_translations.title: Rahbariyat va yoshlar uchrashuvi!
news_translations.summary: BuxDTUda talabalar bilan o'tkazilgan ochiq muloqotda kiberxavfsizlik, yo'l harakati xavfsizligi va yoshlarning ma'naviy rivoji masalalari muhokama qilindi.
news_translations.content:
Buxoro davlat texnika universitetida viloyat ichki ishlar va yo'l harakati xavfsizligi tizimi mutaxassislari hamda universitet rahbariyati ishtirokida 'Rahbar va yoshlar' uchrashuvi o'tkazildi.

Uchrashuv davomida talabalar bilan ochiq muloqot tashkil etilib, kiberxavfsizlik, yo'l harakati qoidalari va yoshlarning ma'naviy-ma'rifiy kamoloti bilan bog'liq muhim masalalar ko'rib chiqildi.

Ishtirokchilar o'zlarini qiziqtirgan savollarga mutaxassislardan bevosita javob oldilar hamda amaliy tavsiyalar bilan tanishdilar.

Mazkur tadbir universitetda xavfsiz, ongli va mas'uliyatli talabalar muhitini shakllantirishga xizmat qildi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTUda talabalar bilan o'tkazilgan ochiq muloqotda kiberxavfsizlik, yo'l harakati xavfsizligi va yoshlarning ma'naviy rivoji masalalari muhokama qilindi.

news_translations.title: Встреча руководства и молодёжи!
news_translations.summary: На встрече со студентами в БГТУ обсуждались вопросы кибербезопасности, дорожной безопасности и духовно-нравственного развития молодёжи.
news_translations.content:
В Бухарском государственном техническом университете состоялась встреча «Руководитель и молодёжь» с участием представителей региональных структур внутренних дел, дорожной безопасности и руководства университета по работе с молодёжью.

В формате открытого диалога со студентами были рассмотрены важные вопросы кибербезопасности, соблюдения правил дорожного движения и духовно-нравственного воспитания молодёжи.

Участники получили ответы на интересующие их вопросы и ознакомились с практическими рекомендациями специалистов.

Мероприятие способствовало формированию в университете безопасной, осознанной и ответственной студенческой среды.
news_translations.meta_description: На встрече со студентами в БГТУ обсуждались вопросы кибербезопасности, дорожной безопасности и духовно-нравственного развития молодёжи.

news_translations.title: لقاء بين القيادة والشباب!
news_translations.summary: ناقش لقاء مفتوح مع طلاب الجامعة قضايا الأمن السيبراني وسلامة المرور والتربية المعنوية للشباب بمشاركة مسؤولين من الجامعة والجهات الإقليمية.
news_translations.content:
عُقد في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية لقاء «القائد والشباب» بمشاركة ممثلين عن الجهات الأمنية وسلامة المرور، إلى جانب قيادة الجامعة المعنية بشؤون الشباب.

وخلال اللقاء جرى نقاش مفتوح مع الطلاب حول قضايا مهمة تتعلق بالأمن السيبراني، والسلامة المرورية، وتعزيز النمو المعنوي والروحي للشباب.

وأتيحت للمشاركين فرصة طرح أسئلتهم مباشرة والحصول على توصيات عملية من المختصين.

وساهمت الفعالية في ترسيخ بيئة جامعية آمنة وواعية ومسؤولة بين الطلاب.
news_translations.meta_description: ناقش لقاء مفتوح مع طلاب الجامعة قضايا الأمن السيبراني وسلامة المرور والتربية المعنوية للشباب بمشاركة مسؤولين من الجامعة والجهات الإقليمية.

news_translations.title: Hero of Uzbekistan!
news_translations.summary: Students met with Hero of Uzbekistan Martiya Akhmedovna Rakhmatova and drew inspiration from her life path, service, and achievements.
news_translations.content:
A meeting with Hero of Uzbekistan Martiya Akhmedovna Rakhmatova was held at Bukhara State Technical University.

During the event, the guest shared her life journey, major achievements, and experiences that carry important lessons for the younger generation.

Students received answers to their questions and drew inspiration and motivation from the conversation.

Such meetings play an important role in strengthening patriotic spirit among youth and encouraging them to strive for meaningful achievements.
news_translations.meta_description: Students met with Hero of Uzbekistan Martiya Akhmedovna Rakhmatova and drew inspiration from her life path, service, and achievements.

news_translations.title: O'zbekiston Qahramoni!
news_translations.summary: BuxDTU talabalari O'zbekiston Qahramoni Martiya Axmedovna Rahmatova bilan uchrashib, uning hayot yo'li va yutuqlaridan ilhom oldilar.
news_translations.content:
Buxoro davlat texnika universitetida O'zbekiston Qahramoni Martiya Axmedovna Rahmatova bilan uchrashuv bo'lib o'tdi.

Tadbir davomida mehmon yoshlarga o'zining hayot yo'li, mehnat faoliyati, erishgan yutuqlari va tajribasi haqida so'zlab berdi.

Talabalar o'zlarini qiziqtirgan savollarga javob olib, uchrashuvdan katta ruhiy ko'tarinkilik va motivatsiya oldilar.

Bunday tadbirlar yoshlarning vatanparvarlik ruhini mustahkamlash va ularni yuksak marralar sari ruhlantirishda muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi.
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTU talabalari O'zbekiston Qahramoni Martiya Axmedovna Rahmatova bilan uchrashib, uning hayot yo'li va yutuqlaridan ilhom oldilar.

news_translations.title: Герой Узбекистана!
news_translations.summary: Студенты БГТУ встретились с Героем Узбекистана Мартией Ахмедовной Рахматовой и получили вдохновение от её жизненного пути и достижений.
news_translations.content:
В Бухарском государственном техническом университете состоялась встреча с Героем Узбекистана Мартией Ахмедовной Рахматовой.

Во время мероприятия гостья рассказала молодёжи о своём жизненном пути, трудовой деятельности, достижениях и опыте, имеющем большое воспитательное значение.

Студенты получили ответы на свои вопросы и вынесли из встречи сильную мотивацию и вдохновение.

Подобные мероприятия играют важную роль в укреплении патриотического духа молодёжи и побуждают её стремиться к высоким целям.
news_translations.meta_description: Студенты БГТУ встретились с Героем Узбекистана Мартией Ахмедовной Рахматовой и получили вдохновение от её жизненного пути и достижений.

news_translations.title: بطل أوزبكستان!
news_translations.summary: التقى طلاب جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية ببطل أوزبكستان مارتيا أخميدوفنا رحمتوفا واستلهموا من مسيرتها وإنجازاتها الوطنية.
news_translations.content:
أُقيم في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية لقاء مع بطل أوزبكستان مارتيا أخميدوفنا رحمتوفا.

وخلال اللقاء تحدثت الضيفة عن مسيرتها الحياتية، وخبراتها، وإنجازاتها، والدروس المهمة التي يمكن أن يستفيد منها الشباب.

وحصل الطلاب على إجابات لأسئلتهم واستمدوا من اللقاء قدرًا كبيرًا من الإلهام والدافعية.

وتؤدي مثل هذه اللقاءات دورًا مهمًا في ترسيخ روح الوطنية لدى الشباب وتشجيعهم على السعي نحو إنجازات كبرى.
news_translations.meta_description: التقى طلاب جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية ببطل أوزبكستان مارتيا أخميدوفنا رحمتوفا واستلهموا من مسيرتها وإنجازاتها الوطنية.

news_translations.title: Engineers of the Future
news_translations.summary: The international festival Engineers of the Future launched with major competitions, international guests, and broad participation from BSTU students and staff.
news_translations.content:
The International Festival Engineers of the Future was officially launched with a keynote address by the First Deputy Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation, Sardor Radjabov.

Around 30 competitions and contests were organized within the festival, bringing together more than 14,000 participants in a single venue focused on innovation, science, and technology.

Distinguished international guests enriched the event with their participation and remarks.

The BSTU team and students, led by Rector Sadoqat Siddiqova, actively presented innovative projects, technological developments, and engineering ideas while exchanging practical experience.
news_translations.meta_description: The international festival Engineers of the Future launched with major competitions, international guests, and broad participation from BSTU students and staff.

news_translations.title: Kelajak muhandislari
news_translations.summary: Kelajak muhandislari xalqaro festivali ko'plab musobaqalar, xalqaro mehmonlar va BuxDTU talabalarining faol ishtiroki bilan rasman boshlandi.
news_translations.content:
Kelajak muhandislari xalqaro festivali tantanali ravishda start oldi va uni Oliy ta'lim, fan va innovatsiyalar vazirining birinchi o'rinbosari Sardor Radjabov kirish nutqi bilan ochib berdi.

Festival doirasida 30 ga yaqin tanlov va musobaqalar tashkil etilib, bir maydonga 14 mingdan ortiq ishtirokchi jamlandi.

Nufuzli xorijiy mehmonlar ham tadbirda ishtirok etib, festival mazmunini boyitdilar.

Rektor Sadoqat Siddiqova boshchiligidagi BuxDTU jamoasi va talabalari o'zlarining innovatsion loyihalari, texnologik ishlanmalari va muhandislik g'oyalari bilan faol qatnashdilar.
news_translations.meta_description: Kelajak muhandislari xalqaro festivali ko'plab musobaqalar, xalqaro mehmonlar va BuxDTU talabalarining faol ishtiroki bilan rasman boshlandi.

news_translations.title: Инженеры будущего
news_translations.summary: Международный фестиваль «Инженеры будущего» официально стартовал, объединив масштабные конкурсы, зарубежных гостей и активное участие студентов БГТУ.
news_translations.content:
Международный фестиваль «Инженеры будущего» был торжественно открыт вступительной речью первого заместителя министра высшего образования, науки и инноваций Сардора Раджабова.

В рамках фестиваля было организовано около 30 конкурсов и состязаний, которые собрали более 14 тысяч участников на одной площадке.

В фестивале также приняли участие авторитетные зарубежные гости, обогатившие программу своими выступлениями и опытом.

Команда и студенты БГТУ во главе с ректором Садокат Сиддиковой активно представили инновационные проекты, технологические разработки и инженерные идеи.
news_translations.meta_description: Международный фестиваль «Инженеры будущего» официально стартовал, объединив масштабные конкурсы, зарубежных гостей и активное участие студентов БГТУ.

news_translations.title: مهندسو المستقبل
news_translations.summary: انطلق مهرجان «مهندسو المستقبل» الدولي رسميًا بمشاركة واسعة من طلاب الجامعة وضيوف دوليين وعشرات المسابقات العلمية والتقنية.
news_translations.content:
انطلق مهرجان «مهندسو المستقبل» الدولي رسميًا بكلمة افتتاحية ألقاها النائب الأول لوزير التعليم العالي والعلوم والابتكار سردار رجبوف.

وشهد المهرجان تنظيم نحو 30 مسابقة وفعالية جمعت أكثر من 14 ألف مشارك في مساحة واحدة مخصصة للابتكار والعلم والتكنولوجيا.

كما شارك في الحدث ضيوف دوليون بارزون أضفوا على المهرجان قيمة علمية وخبرة عملية إضافية.

وشارك فريق جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية وطلابها، بقيادة رئيسة الجامعة سادوقات صديقوفا، بفاعلية من خلال عرض مشروعات ابتكارية وأفكار هندسية وتقنية متنوعة.
news_translations.meta_description: انطلق مهرجان «مهندسو المستقبل» الدولي رسميًا بمشاركة واسعة من طلاب الجامعة وضيوف دوليين وعشرات المسابقات العلمية والتقنية.

news_translations.title: Visit of a Foreign Professor!
news_translations.summary: Professor Deni Darmawan visited BSTU, signed a cooperation memorandum, and led a seminar on modern educational technologies and international academic practice.
news_translations.content:
A distinguished foreign scholar, Deni Darmawan, visited Bukhara State Technical University, marking an important step in the development of international cooperation and academic ties.

The guest has a strong international scientific profile, including an h-index of 52 in major research databases such as Scopus.

During the visit, a memorandum was signed between BSTU and Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia, creating a foundation for joint educational programs, faculty and student exchange, and collaborative research.

Professor Darmawan also conducted a seminar-training session on modern educational technologies, innovative approaches, and international experience for faculty members, researchers, and students.
news_translations.meta_description: Professor Deni Darmawan visited BSTU, signed a cooperation memorandum, and led a seminar on modern educational technologies and international academic practice.

news_translations.title: Xorijiy professor tashrifi!
news_translations.summary: Professor Deni Darmawan BuxDTUga tashrif buyurib, hamkorlik memorandumi imzoladi va zamonaviy ta'lim texnologiyalariga bag'ishlangan seminar o'tkazdi.
news_translations.content:
Nufuzli xorijiy olim Deni Darmawan Buxoro davlat texnika universitetiga tashrif buyurdi va bu tashrif xalqaro hamkorlikni yanada rivojlantirishdagi muhim qadam bo'ldi.

Mehmon Scopus kabi xalqaro ilmiy bazalarda yuqori ko'rsatkichlarga ega bo'lib, uning ilmiy salohiyati universitet jamoasida katta qiziqish uyg'otdi.

Tashrif doirasida BuxDTU va Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia o'rtasida memorandum imzolandi, unda qo'shma ta'lim dasturlari, talabalar va professor-o'qituvchilar almashinuvi hamda ilmiy loyihalar rejalashtirildi.

Shuningdek, professor tomonidan zamonaviy ta'lim texnologiyalari va xalqaro tajribaga bag'ishlangan seminar-trening o'tkazildi.
news_translations.meta_description: Professor Deni Darmawan BuxDTUga tashrif buyurib, hamkorlik memorandumi imzoladi va zamonaviy ta'lim texnologiyalariga bag'ishlangan seminar o'tkazdi.

news_translations.title: Визит зарубежного профессора!
news_translations.summary: Профессор Дени Дармаван посетил БГТУ, подписал меморандум о сотрудничестве и провёл семинар по современным образовательным технологиям.
news_translations.content:
Известный зарубежный учёный Дени Дармаван посетил Бухарский государственный технический университет, и этот визит стал важным шагом в развитии международного сотрудничества.

Гость обладает высоким научным авторитетом, в том числе высоким h-индексом в международных базах, таких как Scopus.

В рамках визита между БГТУ и Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia был подписан меморандум, предусматривающий совместные образовательные программы, обмен студентами и преподавателями, а также совместные исследования.

Кроме того, профессор провёл семинар-тренинг, посвящённый современным образовательным технологиям, инновационным подходам и международному опыту.
news_translations.meta_description: Профессор Дени Дармаван посетил БГТУ, подписал меморандум о сотрудничестве и провёл семинар по современным образовательным технологиям.

news_translations.title: زيارة أستاذ أجنبي!
news_translations.summary: زار الأستاذ ديني دارماوان جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية، وتم توقيع مذكرة تعاون وعقد ندوة تدريبية حول التقنيات التعليمية الحديثة والخبرة الدولية.
news_translations.content:
قام العالم الأجنبي البارز ديني دارماوان بزيارة إلى جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية، وشكلت هذه الزيارة خطوة مهمة في تطوير التعاون الدولي والعلاقات الأكاديمية.

ويتمتع الضيف بمكانة علمية مرموقة، بما في ذلك مؤشر h مرتفع في قواعد البيانات الدولية مثل Scopus.

وفي إطار الزيارة، تم توقيع مذكرة تفاهم بين الجامعة وUniversitas Pendidikan Indonesia لإطلاق برامج تعليمية مشتركة، وتبادل الطلبة وأعضاء هيئة التدريس، وتنفيذ مشروعات بحثية تعاونية.

كما قدّم الأستاذ ندوة تدريبية تناولت التقنيات التعليمية الحديثة، والمقاربات الابتكارية، والخبرات الدولية لفائدة الأساتذة والباحثين والطلاب.
news_translations.meta_description: زار الأستاذ ديني دارماوان جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية، وتم توقيع مذكرة تعاون وعقد ندوة تدريبية حول التقنيات التعليمية الحديثة والخبرة الدولية.

news_translations.title: International Scientific Meeting and Important Attention!
news_translations.summary: A seminar with Nobel laureate Serge Haroche gave regional students and doctoral researchers direct exposure to modern quantum physics and international scientific practice.
news_translations.content:
At Bukhara State Technical University, a seminar-training session was organized for students and doctoral candidates from higher educational institutions across the Bukhara region with the participation of Nobel Prize laureate in quantum physics Serge Haroche.

Participants gained in-depth knowledge and practical insights into modern directions of quantum physics, advanced research approaches, and the future prospects of fundamental science.

The professor's lectures served both as scientific instruction and as a source of motivation for young researchers, who actively participated and engaged in direct dialogue.

The visit and seminar represented an important step in strengthening the integration of science and education, learning from international experience, and advancing the quality of education and research cooperation.
news_translations.meta_title: International Scientific Meeting and Important Attention!
news_translations.meta_description: A seminar with Nobel laureate Serge Haroche gave regional students and doctoral researchers direct exposure to modern quantum physics and international scientific practice.

news_translations.title: Xalqaro ilmiy uchrashuv va muhim e'tibor!
news_translations.summary: Nobel mukofoti sovrindori Serj Arosh ishtirokidagi seminar yosh tadqiqotchilarga kvant fizikasi va xalqaro ilmiy tajriba bo'yicha bevosita bilim berdi.
news_translations.content:
Buxoro davlat texnika universitetida Buxoro viloyatidagi barcha oliy ta'lim muassasalari talabalari va doktorantlari uchun kvant fizikasi bo'yicha Nobel mukofoti sovrindori Serj Arosh ishtirokida seminar-trening tashkil etildi.

Tadbir davomida ishtirokchilar zamonaviy kvant fizikasi yo'nalishlari, ilmiy tadqiqotlarda qo'llaniladigan ilg'or yondashuvlar va fundamental fan istiqbollari bo'yicha chuqur ma'lumot oldilar.

Professorning ma'ruzalari nafaqat ilmiy jihatdan boy bo'ldi, balki yosh tadqiqotchilar uchun kuchli motivatsiya manbai ham bo'ldi.

Mazkur uchrashuv ilm-fan va ta'lim integratsiyasini mustahkamlash, xalqaro tajribani o'rganish hamda yosh olimlar salohiyatini oshirishda muhim qadam bo'ldi.
news_translations.meta_title: Xalqaro ilmiy uchrashuv va muhim e'tibor!
news_translations.meta_description: Nobel mukofoti sovrindori Serj Arosh ishtirokidagi seminar yosh tadqiqotchilarga kvant fizikasi va xalqaro ilmiy tajriba bo'yicha bevosita bilim berdi.

news_translations.title: Международная научная встреча и важное внимание!
news_translations.summary: Семинар с лауреатом Нобелевской премии Серже Арошем дал молодым исследователям региона прямой доступ к современным знаниям о квантовой физике и международной научной практике.
news_translations.content:
В Бухарском государственном техническом университете был организован семинар-тренинг для студентов и докторантов вузов Бухарской области с участием лауреата Нобелевской премии по квантовой физике Сержа Ароша.

Участники получили углублённые знания о современных направлениях квантовой физики, передовых научных подходах и перспективах фундаментальной науки.

Лекции профессора были не только содержательными с научной точки зрения, но и послужили мощным источником вдохновения для молодых исследователей.

Эта встреча стала важным шагом в укреплении интеграции науки и образования, изучении международного опыта и развитии потенциала молодых учёных.
news_translations.meta_title: Международная научная встреча и важное внимание!
news_translations.meta_description: Семинар с лауреатом Нобелевской премии Серже Арошем дал молодым исследователям региона прямой доступ к современным знаниям о квантовой физике и международной научной практике.

news_translations.title: لقاء علمي دولي واهتمام كبير!
news_translations.summary: منحت ندوة بمشاركة الحائز على نوبل سيرج هاروش طلاب وباحثي المنطقة فرصة مباشرة للتعرف إلى أحدث اتجاهات فيزياء الكم والخبرة العلمية الدولية.
news_translations.content:
نُظمت في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية ندوة تدريبية لطلبة الدراسات العليا والطلاب من مؤسسات التعليم العالي في ولاية بخارى بمشاركة الحائز على جائزة نوبل في فيزياء الكم سيرج هاروش.

واكتسب المشاركون معرفة معمقة حول الاتجاهات الحديثة في فيزياء الكم، وأحدث مناهج البحث العلمي، وآفاق العلوم الأساسية في المستقبل.

ولم تكن محاضرات الأستاذ ثرية من الناحية العلمية فحسب، بل مثلت أيضًا مصدر إلهام قوي للباحثين الشباب.

وقد شكّل هذا اللقاء خطوة مهمة لتعزيز تكامل العلم والتعليم، والاستفادة من الخبرة الدولية، ورفع إمكانات العلماء الشباب.
news_translations.meta_description: منحت ندوة بمشاركة الحائز على نوبل سيرج هاروش طلاب وباحثي المنطقة فرصة مباشرة للتعرف إلى أحدث اتجاهات فيزياء الكم والخبرة العلمية الدولية.

news_translations.title: Priority Directions and Prospects of Innovative Technologies in the Cotton, Textile, Light, and Leather Industries
news_translations.summary: BSTU hosted an international scientific and practical conference focused on innovation, industrial modernization, and future development in the cotton and textile sectors.
news_translations.content:
An international scientific and practical conference was held on the topic of priority directions and future prospects of innovative technologies in the cotton, textile, light, and leather industries.

The conference opened with a welcoming speech by Rector Sadoqat Siddiqova, who outlined current priorities, innovative approaches, and promising sector trends.

The event served as an important platform that brought together science, innovation, and industry to advance new ideas and practical solutions for the field.

The conference reinforced BSTU's role in connecting academic expertise with the modernization of strategically important industries.
news_translations.meta_title: Priority Directions and Prospects of Innovative Technologies in the Cotton, Textile, Light, and Leather Industries
news_translations.meta_description: BSTU hosted an international scientific and practical conference focused on innovation, industrial modernization, and future development in the cotton and textile sectors.

news_translations.title: Paxta, to'qimachilik, yengil va charm sanoatida innovatsion texnologiyalarning ustuvor yo'nalishlari hamda istiqbollari
news_translations.summary: BuxDTUda paxta-to'qimachilik va unga aloqador tarmoqlarda innovatsiyalar hamda sanoatni modernizatsiya qilish masalalariga bag'ishlangan xalqaro konferensiya bo'lib o'tdi.
news_translations.content:
Universitetda paxta, to'qimachilik, yengil va charm sanoatida innovatsion texnologiyalarning ustuvor yo'nalishlari hamda istiqbollariga bag'ishlangan xalqaro ilmiy-amaliy konferensiya bo'lib o'tdi.

Konferensiyani rektor Sadoqat Siddiqova ochib berib, sohadagi dolzarb yo'nalishlar, innovatsion yondashuvlar va istiqbolli rivojlanish tendensiyalari haqida so'z yuritdi.

Mazkur anjuman ilm-fan, innovatsiya va ishlab chiqarishni birlashtirgan muhim muloqot maydoniga aylandi.

Tadbir strategik ahamiyatga ega tarmoqlarni modernizatsiya qilishda universitet ilmiy salohiyatining muhim o'rnini yana bir bor ko'rsatdi.
news_translations.meta_title: Paxta, to'qimachilik, yengil va charm sanoatida innovatsion texnologiyalarning ustuvor yo'nalishlari hamda istiqbollari
news_translations.meta_description: BuxDTUda paxta-to'qimachilik va unga aloqador tarmoqlarda innovatsiyalar hamda sanoatni modernizatsiya qilish masalalariga bag'ishlangan xalqaro konferensiya bo'lib o'tdi.

news_translations.title: Приоритетные направления и перспективы инновационных технологий в хлопковой, текстильной, лёгкой и кожевенной промышленности
news_translations.summary: В БГТУ прошла международная конференция, посвящённая инновациям и модернизации предприятий хлопковой, текстильной, лёгкой и кожевенной промышленности.
news_translations.content:
В университете состоялась международная научно-практическая конференция на тему приоритетных направлений и перспектив инновационных технологий в хлопковой, текстильной, лёгкой и кожевенной промышленности.

Конференцию открыла ректор Садокат Сиддикова, подчеркнув актуальные направления развития отрасли, инновационные подходы и перспективные тенденции.

Форум стал важной площадкой, объединившей науку, инновации и производство для выработки новых идей и решений.

Мероприятие ещё раз подтвердило значимость научного потенциала БГТУ в модернизации стратегически важных отраслей экономики.
news_translations.meta_title: Приоритетные направления и перспективы инновационных технологий в хлопковой, текстильной, лёгкой и кожевенной промышленности
news_translations.meta_description: В БГТУ прошла международная конференция, посвящённая инновациям и модернизации предприятий хлопковой, текстильной, лёгкой и кожевенной промышленности.

news_translations.title: الاتجاهات ذات الأولوية وآفاق التقنيات المبتكرة في صناعات القطن والنسيج والصناعات الخفيفة والجلود
news_translations.summary: استضافت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية مؤتمرًا دوليًا ناقش الابتكار والتحديث الصناعي في قطاعات القطن والنسيج والصناعات الخفيفة والجلود.
news_translations.content:
عُقد في الجامعة مؤتمر علمي عملي دولي حول الاتجاهات ذات الأولوية وآفاق التقنيات المبتكرة في صناعات القطن والنسيج والصناعات الخفيفة والجلود.

افتتحت المؤتمر رئيسة الجامعة سادوقات صديقوفا، متحدثة عن المسارات الراهنة للقطاع، والمقاربات الابتكارية، والاتجاهات الواعدة للتطوير.

وأصبح المؤتمر منصة مهمة جمعت بين العلم والابتكار والإنتاج الصناعي لطرح أفكار وحلول جديدة تخدم هذا المجال.

وأكدت الفعالية مجددًا الدور المهم للإمكانات العلمية للجامعة في تحديث القطاعات الاقتصادية ذات الأهمية الاستراتيجية.
news_translations.meta_title: الاتجاهات ذات الأولوية وآفاق التقنيات المبتكرة في صناعات القطن والنسيج والصناعات الخفيفة والجلود
news_translations.meta_description: استضافت جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية مؤتمرًا دوليًا ناقش الابتكار والتحديث الصناعي في قطاعات القطن والنسيج والصناعات الخفيفة والجلود.

news_translations.title: Future Engineers Festival
news_translations.summary: The University Cup winners within the Future Engineers Festival were ceremoniously recognized for achievements in AI, cybersecurity, robotics, drones, and more.
news_translations.content:
Within the framework of the Future Engineers Festival, the winners of the University Cup competition were ceremoniously awarded.

Prize-winning places were awarded across several competitive areas, including artificial intelligence, CTF cybersecurity, drone competitions, and robotics, with Grand Prix distinctions also announced.

The results highlighted the diversity of student talent and the practical orientation of the festival's engineering and digital tracks.

Winners received diplomas and cash prizes from the university, further motivating students toward excellence in applied technology fields.
