administration_profile_translations.details: تنظيم تنفيذ قوانين جمهورية أوزبكستان والمراسيم والقرارات الرئاسية في مجال التعليم؛ إدارة وتنسيق الأنشطة المالية والاقتصادية للجامعة؛ إدارة أعمال قسم التخطيط والميزانية والحسابات وقسم التسويق؛ تنظيم أعمال التشييد والترميم والصيانة وإعمار الحرم الجامعي؛ جذب الأموال غير الميزانية من خلال تقديم خدمات مدفوعة إضافية؛ تشكيل الموارد المالية لعقود الطلاب؛ إعداد تقديرات الإيرادات والمصروفات للميزانية الحكومية وعقود الطلاب؛ مراقبة الميزانيات المعتمدة والأنشطة المالية للجامعة؛ تجهيز المباني الدراسية والسكن الطلابي للعام الدراسي الجديد; تطوير التدابير اللازمة لتنمية القاعدة المادية والتقنية للجامعة؛ تنظيم العمل على جذب الاستثمارات الخارجية والمحلية؛ مراجعة مشاريع إعادة الإعمار والترميم للمباني ومراقبة جودتها؛ مراقبة الالتزام بالأنظمة المالية والمحاسبية والميزانيات المعتمدة؛ اتخاذ التدابير لترشيد استخدام أموال الميزانية وخدمات المرافق العامة؛ تحسين شروط دفع أجور أعضاء هيئة التدريس والموظفين؛ ضمان الصرف الفوري لرواتب العاملين والمنح الدراسية للطلاب؛ متابعة تحصيل الرسوم الدراسية من طلاب عقود التعليم بانتظام.

administration_profile_translations.about: Dr. Murodjon U. Djurayev directs the international relations of Bukhara State Technical University. He manages bilateral academic exchange partnerships, foreign project grants, and the integration of international educational standards. Dr. Djurayev oversees the university's double-degree agreements with leading European and Asian universities, facilitating student and staff mobility.
administration_profile_translations.details: Coordinates global double-degree programs, manages international exchange projects (e.g. Erasmus+), and oversees international student enrollments. Focuses on expanding the global footprint of BSTU, forming agreements with prestigious institutions globally, and facilitating staff and student research exchanges.
administration_profile_translations.achievements: ["Signed double-degree agreements with 6 foreign universities in Europe and Asia.","Secured funding for 3 new Erasmus+ capacity-building projects.","Doubled the enrollment of international students at the university."]

administration_profile_translations.about: Dr. Murodjon U. Djurayev Buxoro davlat texnika universitetining xalqaro aloqalarini boshqaradi. U ikki tomonlama akademik almashinuv hamkorliklari, xalqaro grant loyihalari hamda ta'lim standartlarini xalqaro me'yorlarga moslashtirish jarayonlariga rahbarlik qiladi. Shuningdek, Yevropa va Osiyodagi yetakchi universitetlar bilan qo'shma diplom dasturlari bo'yicha kelishuvlarni muvofiqlashtirib, talabalar hamda professor-o'qituvchilarning akademik mobilligini kengaytiradi.
administration_profile_translations.details: Xalqaro qo'shma ta'lim dasturlarini muvofiqlashtiradi, xalqaro almashinuv loyihalarini (masalan, Erasmus+) boshqaradi va chet ellik talabalarning o'qishini nazorat qiladi. BSTUning xalqaro hamjamiyatdagi nufuzini oshirish va xorijiy hamkorlar bilan kelishuvlar imzolashga e'tibor qaratadi.
administration_profile_translations.achievements: ["Yevropa va Osiyodagi 6 ta yetakchi xorijiy universitetlar bilan qo'shma diplom shartnomalarini imzoladi.","3 ta yangi Erasmus+ loyihasi uchun grant mablag'larini jalb qildi.","Universitetda chet ellik talabalar sonini ikki baravarga ko'paytirdi."]

administration_profile_translations.about: Д-р Муроджон У. Джураев руководит международным направлением Бухарского государственного технического университета. Он координирует двусторонние академические обмены, международные грантовые проекты и внедрение международных образовательных стандартов. Также он курирует соглашения о программах двойных дипломов с ведущими университетами Европы и Азии, расширяя академическую мобильность студентов и профессорско-преподавательского состава.
administration_profile_translations.details: Координирует глобальные программы двойных дипломов, управляет проектами международного обмена (например, Erasmus+) и курирует прием иностранных студентов. Направляет усилия на расширение присутствия BSTU на мировой арене и заключение договоров с зарубежными партнерами.

administration_profile_translations.degree: دكتوراه في العلوم المعمارية، أستاذ مشارك
administration_profile_translations.about: يدير الدكتور مرادجون أو. دجوراييف ملف العلاقات الدولية في جامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية. ويشرف على شراكات التبادل الأكاديمي الثنائية، ومشروعات المنح الدولية، ومواءمة البرامج التعليمية مع المعايير الدولية. كما يتابع اتفاقيات الدرجات المزدوجة مع جامعات رائدة في أوروبا وآسيا، بما يعزز تنقل الطلبة وأعضاء هيئة التدريس أكاديمياً.
administration_profile_translations.details: ينسق برامج الدرجات المزدوجة العالمية، ويدير مشاريع التبادل الدولي (مثل Erasmus+)، ويشرف على تسجيل الطلاب الدوليين. يركز على توسيع الحضور العالمي لجامعة بخارى وتوقيع اتفاقيات التعاون مع شركاء دوليين.

university_center_setting_translations.support_desc: لديك أسئلة حول دورات معينة، معدات البحث، أو المرافق؟ اتصل بالمدير.

university_center_translations.name: Digital Educational Technologies Centre
university_center_translations.head: Muxlis Maxmudov
university_center_translations.head_title: Director of the Digital Technologies Center
university_center_translations.about: The current DET traces its origins back to the 1980s. Initially, in 1978, the 'Computing Center' was established under the Department of 'Applied Mathematics' at the Bukhara Food and Light Industry Technology Institute. Its material and technical base consisted of a computer classroom equipped with ES-1035, version 3, later replaced by IBM PC.AT/XT computers. Extensive work is underway at the university to automate the educational process. Wi-Fi zones have been established on campus. There are 22 computer classrooms with approximately 800 computers in total.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Department for Implementation of Digital Education Technologies","Network Management Department","Technical Support Department","Information Security Department","Extensive work is underway at the university to automate the educational process.","Within DET, a group of 'Developers' has been formed who develop and maintain programs such as the electronic journal, electronic library, distance learning system 'Moodle,' and other applications.","Wi-Fi zones have been established on campus for student internet access.","Bukhara State Technical University is connected to a corporate network via optical cable in partnership with Bukhara Telecom.","The center maintains contractual relationships with clients and suppliers of technical resources and equipment based on the types of services and works provided."]

university_center_translations.name: Raqamli ta'lim texnologiyalari markazi
university_center_translations.head: Muxlis Maxmudov
university_center_translations.about: Markaz universitetning o'quv jarayonini avtomatlashtirish, kompyuter sinflari va tarmoqlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan shug'ullanadi. Kampusda talabalarning internetga kirishi uchun Wi-Fi zonalari tashkil etilgan. Jami 22 ta kompyuter sinfi mavjud bo'lib, 800 ga yaqin kompyuter o'quv jarayoniga xizmat qilmoqda.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Raqamli ta'lim texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo'limi;","Tarmoqlarni boshqarish bo'limi;","Texnik qo'llab-quvvatlash bo'limi;","Axborot xavfsizligi bo'limi;","Elektron jurnal, elektron kutubxona va masofaviy ta'lim tizimi (Moodle) dasturlarini ishlab chiqish va qo'llab-quvvatlash;","Talabalar internetga kirishi uchun Wi-Fi zonalarini yaratish;","Kompyuter sinflari va IT-uskunalariga texnik xizmat ko'rsatish;","Internet xizmatlari va kompyuter texnikasi yetkazib beruvchilari bilan shartnomaviy munosabatlarni yuritish."]

university_center_translations.name: Центр цифровых образовательных технологий
university_center_translations.head: Мухлис Махмудов
university_center_translations.about: Центр занимается автоматизацией учебного процесса, поддержкой компьютерных классов и сетей университета. В кампусе созданы зоны Wi-Fi для доступа студентов к интернету. Имеется 22 компьютерных класса с примерно 800 компьютерами.

university_center_translations.name: مركز تقنيات التعليم الرقمي
university_center_translations.head: مخلص محمودوف
university_center_translations.about: يعود تاريخ المركز إلى الثمانينيات. ويشرف حالياً على إدارة الشبكات المحلية والخوادم وتطوير البرمجيات والأنظمة التعليمية مثل HEMIS و Moodle. وتعمل الجامعة بجد على أتمتة العمليات التعليمية بالكامل وتوفير شبكات الـ Wi-Fi.

university_center_translations.name: Сhancellery and archival department
university_center_translations.head: Barnoyeva Gulshanxon Subxidinovna
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of Chancellery and archival department
university_center_translations.about: The Office is an independent structural subdivision of the institute and reports directly to the Rector according to the institute’s charter. The Office operates based on the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan, Decrees, Orders, and Resolutions of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, Resolutions and Orders of the Cabinet of Ministers, decisions made by the Council, and relevant regulatory and methodological documents.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Organizing work processes at the institute, ensuring discipline in document management, and maintaining confidentiality in document handling.","Monitoring the deadlines and quality of documents received from higher authorities.","Ensuring timely execution of documents assigned to employees.","Ensuring the use, accounting, and safekeeping of stamps and seals used in document management.","Monitoring the implementation of management decisions.","Organizing the timely transfer of documents with expired retention periods to the archive.","Studying and supervising document management within the institute.","Controlling the departments and journals within the institute\u2019s structure, ensuring timely and correct registration of incoming and outgoing documents.","Receiving letters and documents and sending reply letters on time.","Distributing documents to deans\u2019 offices and departments and monitoring their execution.","Taking measures to improve the qualifications of office and archive staff.","The Office is responsible for ensuring the fulfillment of all tasks assigned by these regulations and other normative legal documents.","The Office has its own round seal, which is kept by the Head of the Office.","Perform office duties honestly, conscientiously, and observe labor discipline.","Properly register documents received from the Oliy Majlis, Presidential Office, Cabinet of Ministers, and other ministries, and deliver to executors.","Ensure proper official formatting of outgoing documents from the institute.","Promptly deliver incoming documents to executors through the automated system (edo.ijro.uz).","Keep account of institute forms and regularly report to the institute Rector on all activities related to the Office."]

university_center_translations.name: Devonxona va arxiv bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Barnoyeva Gulshanxon Subxidinovna
university_center_translations.about: Devonxona institutning mustaqil tarkibiy bo'linmasi bo'lib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri rektorga bo'ysunadi. Bo'lim hujjatlar aylanishini, kiruvchi va chiquvchi xatlarni hamda arxiv ishlarini muvofiqlashtiradi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Institutda ish jarayonlarini tashkil etish, ish yuritish va hujjatlar bilan ishlashda maxfiylikni ta'minlash;","Yuqori organlardan kelgan hujjatlarning bajarilish muddati va sifatini nazorat qilish;","Xodimlarga yuklatilgan hujjatlarning o'z vaqtida bajarilishini ta'minlash;","Hujjat aylanishida muhr va shtamplardan to'g'ri foydalanish hamda saqlanishini nazorat qilish;","Rahbariyat qarorlari ijrosini nazorat qilish;","Muddati tugagan hujjatlarni arxivga topshirishni tashkil etish."]

university_center_translations.name: Канцелярия и архивный отдел
university_center_translations.head: Барноева Гульшанхон Субхидиновна
university_center_translations.about: Канцелярия является самостоятельным структурным подразделением института и подчиняется непосредственно ректору. Она координирует документооборот, входящую и исходящую корреспонденцию, а также архивные дела.

university_center_translations.name: قسم الديوان والأرشيف (السكرتارية)
university_center_translations.head: بارنويفا جولشانخون سوبخيدينوفنا
university_center_translations.about: الديوان هو وحدة هيكلية مستقلة في المعهد ويتبع مباشرة لرئيس الجامعة وفقاً لميثاق المعهد وقوانين جمهورية أوزبكستان. يختص بتنظيم عمليات تدفق المستندات والحفاظ على سرية تداولها وأرشفتها.

university_center_translations.name: Monitoring and inner Control Department
university_center_translations.head: Jalol S. Radjabov
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of Monitoring and inner Control Department
university_center_translations.about: In its activities, the department complies with the Laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan, Decrees, Resolutions, and Orders of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, decisions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan, this Regulation, institute orders and Council decisions, as well as other normative legal acts.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Directly leads the department, organizes the work of the department staff, and is fully responsible for the implementation of tasks and functions assigned to the department in accordance with this Regulation.","Implements measures to improve the department's activities and enhance the qualifications of himself\/herself and the staff.","Monitors the timely execution of legislative documents and assignments by divisions through the 'Ijro.gov.uz' and 'Edo.ijro.uz' systems, reviews the effectiveness of their implementation at meetings of the Institute Rector and Council, and submits consolidated reports with relevant proposals;","Proposes suggestions to the Rector aimed at increasing the efficiency of organizing the implementation of legislative documents and assignments, as well as strengthening the responsibility of officials in ensuring discipline of execution within institute divisions.","Submits proposals to the institute leadership regarding disciplinary actions against responsible employees in the institute\u2019s departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments who violate execution discipline.","Organizes systematic and targeted study of the execution discipline situation in the institute\u2019s departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments. Prepares documents related to department activities, ensures consideration of submitted drafts, and prepares proposals.","Reviews appeals from individuals and legal entities related to department activities and fully complies with execution discipline.","Develops and ensures the implementation of measures to further improve the department's work.","Controls timely receipt, registration according to established procedures, and delivery to the institute leadership and its structural divisions of letters and documents received from the Administration of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, the Cabinet of Ministers, other ministries, and agencies.","Organizes and coordinates the quality work activity of employees in accordance with the department's work plan and assigned service duties.","Monitors documentation of management activities, sending letters, and preparation and formalization of internal documents.","Provides appropriate practical and methodological assistance for record-keeping in the institute and its divisions, and supervises their work.","Cooperates with divisions to improve established procedures in record-keeping and document management.","Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute by decrees, resolutions, and orders of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan;","Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute by resolutions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan;","Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute based on protocols of meetings held by the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan and assignments from the Administration of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan;","Conducts systematic monitoring of the execution of tasks assigned to the institute by documents of the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovations (orders, joint decisions, assignments, letters, etc.);","Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of orders of the Rector of the institute by structural divisions, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments;","Based on the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan 'On Appeals of Physical and Legal Persons' and the Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 341, the department continuously monitors and supervises timely and proper consideration of appeals by institute divisions;","Immediately informs the Rector about any violations of deadlines and procedures for consideration of appeals by responsible executors;","Provides the Rector with necessary information and data on execution of legislative documents, assignments, and appeals of physical and legal persons;","Regularly analyzes the execution status of tasks assigned to the institute in laws, decrees, protocols of meetings with the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, resolutions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers, and ministry documents; identifies shortcomings and issues requiring urgent resolution and submits them for discussion at meetings with the Rector and the Council;","Regularly analyzes the implementation of institute orders by departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments; identifies urgent issues and submits them for discussion to the Rector and institute Council;","Registers and examines incoming appeals (applications, complaints, suggestions) from physical and legal persons through the President\u2019s Virtual Reception, Prime Minister\u2019s Virtual Receptions, ministries, and other relevant organizations in accordance with established procedures and deadlines, and ensures delivery to the executor after content review;","Controls that responsible employees send reply letters (to the author of the appeal, relevant organizations, and agencies) within the established deadlines;","Develops the schedule for reception of representatives of physical and legal persons by heads of divisions and responsible employees, and organizes oral receptions at the institute based on this schedule (approved by the Rector);","Conducts monthly, quarterly, and annual analyses on the status of consideration of appeals received by the institute, and reports to the Rector and Council meetings;","Prepares analytical reports on timely consideration of appeals by the institute\u2019s divisions, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments, and submits quarterly reports to the Ministry;","Controls documents, assignments, and execution of tasks in lyceums and technical schools within the institute\u2019s organizational structure;","Carries out systematic activities related to appeals of individuals and legal entities directly related to the department's activities and strengthens execution discipline."]

university_center_translations.name: Monitoring va ichki nazorat bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Jalol S. Radjabov
university_center_translations.head_title: Monitoring va ichki nazorat bo'limi boshlig'i
university_center_translations.about: O'z faoliyatida bo'lim O'zbekiston Respublikasi qonunlari, Prezident farmon va qarorlari, Vazirlar Mahkamasi qarorlari hamda institut Kengashi qarorlariga amal qiladi. Bo'lim ijro intizomini va hujjatlar bajarilishini nazorat qiladi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Bo'lim faoliyatini boshqaradi, xodimlar ishini tashkil etadi va Nizom talablari bajarilishi uchun to'liq javob beradi;","Ijro intizomini oshirish bo'yicha chora-tadbirlarni amalga oshiradi;","Ijro.gov.uz va Edo.ijro.uz tizimlari orqali topshiriqlar bajarilishini nazorat qiladi;","Jismoniy va yuridik shaxslarning murojaatlari o'z vaqtida ko'rib chiqilishini nazorat qiladi."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел мониторинга и внутреннего контроля
university_center_translations.head: Джалол С. Раджабов
university_center_translations.head_title: Начальник отдела мониторинга и внутреннего контроля
university_center_translations.about: В своей деятельности отдел руководствуется законами Республики Узбекистан, указами, постановлениями и распоряжениями Президента Республики Узбекистан, решениями и распоряжениями Кабинета Министров, а также внутренними приказами и решениями Совета института.

university_center_translations.name: قسم الرقابة والتدقيق الداخلي
university_center_translations.head: جلال س. راجابوف
university_center_translations.about: يمتثل القسم في أنشطته لقوانين جمهورية أوزبكستان، والمراسيم والقرارات الرئاسية، وقرارات مجلس الوزراء، وقرارات مجلس الجامعة واللوائح الداخلية. يراقب القسم باستمرار ويشرف على النظر في الشكاوى والالتماسات من قبل الوحدات الهيكلية.

university_center_translations.name: Human Resources Department
university_center_translations.head: Jumayeva Gulnoz To‘rayevna
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Human Resources Department
university_center_translations.about: Providing university units with qualified and experienced personnel together with department heads, ensuring effective use of personnel in their positions and keeping their records, and monitoring the attendance and working hours of all university staff.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Providing university units with qualified and experienced personnel together with department heads;","Regularly updating information about professors, teachers, and staff working at the university in the electronic database;","Entering all personnel-related data into relevant systems;","Ensuring effective use of personnel in their positions and keeping their records;","Monitoring the attendance and working hours of all university staff;","Analyzing personnel shortages and providing suggestions on these matters;","Timely implementation of assignments received from higher authorities;","Participating with other department heads in preparing documents related to personnel matters;","Ensuring the safekeeping of personal collective documents of professors, staff, and students (both master\u2019s and bachelor\u2019s) studying at the university;","Determining the timing of faculty selection and supervising the preparation of related information;","Organizing the preparation of certificates and information for employees;","Preparing reports related to personnel issues for the Ministry of Higher Education and other reporting organizations;","Preparing draft orders for hiring, dismissal, and position changes of employees and supervising their submission to management;","Controlling the safekeeping and management of diploma blanks received from the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education;","Monitoring the registration of orders prepared by faculty deans;","Controlling dismissals due to violations of labor discipline in coordination with the trade union;","Monitoring personal collective files and student cards in the student affairs department;","Signing orders related to student affairs prepared by faculty deans in coordination;","Controlling the timely submission of all reports prepared by the Personnel Department;","Controlling the archiving of personal documents of dismissed employees and graduated students;","Annually monitoring the receipt of personal documents of first-year (bachelor) students, master\u2019s students, and those admitted to the second higher education from the admissions committee."]

university_center_translations.name: Xodimlar bo'limi (Kadrlar bo'limi)
university_center_translations.head: Jumayeva Gulnoz To‘rayevna
university_center_translations.about: Xodimlar bo'limi universitetda kadrlar siyosatini amalga oshiradi. U ishga qabul qilish, mehnat shartnomalarini tuzish, shaxsiy yig'majildlarni yuritish va xodimlarni rag'batlantirish ishlarini nazorat qiladi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Kadrlar tarkibini shakllantirish va ulardan unumli foydalanish;","Ishga qabul qilish, boshqa lavozimga o'tkazish va bo'shatishni rasmiylashtirish;","Mehnat daftarchalari va xodimlarning shaxsiy hujjatlarini yuritish;","Mehnat intizomini nazorat qilish va rag'batlantirish chora-tadbirlarini tayyorlash."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел кадров
university_center_translations.head: Джумаева Гульноз Тураевна
university_center_translations.about: Обеспечивает подразделения университета квалифицированными кадрами, ведет учет персонала и контролирует трудовую дисциплину.

university_center_translations.name: قسم الموارد البشرية (شؤون الموظفين)
university_center_translations.head: جوماييفا غولنوز تورايفنا
university_center_translations.about: يختص بتوفير الكوادر المؤهلة والخبرات للأقسام الجامعية، وإدارة ملفات الموظفين ومراقبة انضباط العمل والحضور.

university_center_translations.name: Education Quality Control Department
university_center_translations.head: Murodov Shukhrat Mustafoyevich
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Education Quality Control Department
university_center_translations.about: This Charter defines the status, main purpose, duties, functions, rights, and responsibilities of the Education Quality Control Department within Bukhara State Technical University (hereinafter referred to as the Institute), as well as the procedure for organizing its activities. The Department is part of the university’s structure and is directly accountable to the Ministry’s Department of Organization, Licensing, and Quality Assurance of Educational Institutions.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Control and coordinate the quality of personnel training at the university and bring the educational process in line with state standards;","Study and analyze the conformity of students' knowledge, skills, and competencies with state educational standards, as well as the level of students' subject mastery;","Form a faculty staff capable of ensuring education quality, including selecting qualified teachers, hiring, and providing opportunities for their professional development through objective and transparent organizational mechanisms;","Regularly analyze the quality of teaching by faculty members;","Organize internal evaluation of the university and take measures to eliminate identified deficiencies based on the results;","Organize the educational process in accordance with requirements established in normative legal documents and monitor the effectiveness of the HEMIS system (including timely and accurate data entry, and proper implementation of the credit-modular system);","Analyze the compliance of qualification requirements, curricula, and programs with standards and labor market demands for preparing competitive personnel;","Provide proposals on the position of graduates in the labor market and the need to open new educational directions;","Monitor the organization of classes based on modern pedagogical technologies and multimedia tools, as well as the extensive use of information and communication technologies during lessons;","Monitor the involvement of qualified specialists from industrial enterprises in practical training (as external interns);","Evaluate the effectiveness of measures to ensure transparency and fairness in student knowledge assessment and grading;","Control the faculty composition, monitor their professional development, and study the inclusion of new subjects in educational programs;","Analyze the fair distribution of teaching workload among faculty members;","Analyze the conditions created for students and teachers in the information resource center and the availability of subject programs, and provide recommendations to management;","Analyze the organization of independent study at the required level (develop guidelines or methodological instructions and the appropriate procedures);","Ensure the implementation of anti-plagiarism programs at the university (including the introduction of academic integrity principles and systematic work against plagiarism);","Participate in studying the activities of other higher education institutions upon the Ministry\u2019s instructions;","Analyze students' knowledge compliance with the state educational standards and qualification requirements of the Republic of Uzbekistan;","Improve and revise qualification requirements for educational fields based on employers' proposals aimed at enhancing personnel training quality at higher education institutions;","Conduct expertise of state educational standards, qualification requirements, and curricula developed based on them for all types of education;","Organize and carry out monitoring of educational and training quality and personnel training at the university;","Monitor and ensure fair and objective conduct of subject Olympiads, competitions, and various contests held within the continuous education system, and analyze the results;","Establish international cooperation in the field of education quality assessment;","Conduct control activities, analyze results, identify factors affecting education quality, including monitoring the level of graduates\u2019 educational preparation and teaching quality based on selective studies in general and professional subjects;","Organize intellectual contests and competitions among students aimed at improving education quality and adherence to state educational standards and qualification requirements;","Develop organizational, legal, and methodological guidelines for monitoring and controlling the educational process and personnel training quality;","Conduct monitoring of education and personnel training quality based on modern information and telecommunication technologies;","Prepare analytical reports on education quality assessment results;","Develop control materials aimed at assessing students' and listeners' knowledge;","Conduct social surveys to study the quality of teaching and personnel training in educational institutions;","Organize the preparation of conclusions based on the expert evaluation of education documents submitted for recognition by the Expert Commission;","Inform applicants about the Expert Commission\u2019s conclusions;","Monitor the educational process and personnel training quality and organize the relevant administrative work during the learning process;"]

university_center_translations.name: Ta'lim sifatini nazorat qilish bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Murodov Shukhrat Mustafoyevich
university_center_translations.head_title: Ta'lim sifatini nazorat qilish bo'limi boshlig'i
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim universitetda ta'lim sifatini baholash va nazorat qilish maqsadida tashkil etilgan. U o'quv dasturlarini tahlil qiladi, o'qituvchilar faoliyatini reyting asosida baholaydi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["O'quv jarayoni va ta'lim sifatini doimiy monitoring qilish;","Professot-o'qituvchilar reytingini aniqlash va tahlil qilish;","Ta'lim standartlari va o'quv rejalarining bajarilishini tekshirish;","Talabalar bilimi sifatini sinovlar orqali baholash."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел контроля качества образования
university_center_translations.head: Муродов Шухрат Мустафоевич
university_center_translations.about: Отдел является структурным подразделением университета. Основными обязанностями являются контроль и координация качества подготовки кадров в университете и приведение учебного процесса в соответствие с государственными образовательными стандартами.

university_center_translations.name: قسم مراقبة جودة التعليم
university_center_translations.head: مرادوف شوهرت مصطفيفيتش
university_center_translations.about: يختص القسم بمراقبة وتنسيق جودة تدريب الكوادر وتوافق العملية التعليمية مع معايير التعليم الحكومية الأوزبكية. ويتبع مباشرة لرئيس الجامعة وتوجيهات الوزارة المعنية.

university_center_translations.name: Trade Union Committee
university_center_translations.head: Yuliev Ozod Olimovich
university_center_translations.head_title: Chairman of the Trade Union Committee
university_center_translations.about: The Trade Union Committee is dedicated to representing and protecting the social-economic, labor, and occupational safety rights and interests of its members among staff and students at Bukhara State Technical University.
university_center_translations.functions: ["To achieve the conclusion of collective agreements and oversee their implementation;","To enhance public oversight to ensure compliance with labor laws and occupational safety regulations;","To provide legal advice to trade union members, regulate labor relations, and implement a socially fair wage system for employees;","To organize cultural, educational, physical training, sports, wellness activities, as well as leisure and health improvement events among trade union members.","The purpose of the Trade Union is to represent and protect the social-economic, labor, and occupational safety rights and interests of its members."]

university_center_translations.name: Kasaba uyushmasi qo'mitasi
university_center_translations.head: Yuliev Ozod Olimovich
university_center_translations.about: Kasaba uyushmasi qo'mitasi universitet professor-o'qituvchilari, xodimlari va talabalarining ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy huquqlari hamda manfaatlarini himoya qiladi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Xodimlarning mehnat huquqlarini himoya qilish;","Madaniy-ma'rifiy va sport tadbirlarini tashkil etish;","Xodimlar va talabalarga moddiy yordam ko'rsatish;","Sog'lomlashtirish maskanlariga yo'llanmalar ajratish."]

university_center_translations.name: Профсоюзный комитет
university_center_translations.head: Юлиев Озод Олимович
university_center_translations.about: Представляет и защищает социально-экономические, трудовые права и интересы своих членов среди сотрудников и студентов университета.

university_center_translations.name: اللجنة النقابية (نقابة العاملين والطلاب)
university_center_translations.head: يولييف أوزود أوليموفيتش
university_center_translations.about: تمثل اللجنة النقابية الحقوق والاهتمامات الاجتماعية والاقتصادية والمهنية لأعضائها من موظفين وطلاب بجامعة بخارى الحكومية التقنية.

university_center_translations.name: Educational and Methodical Department
university_center_translations.head: Aziz Khojiyev Kholmurodovich
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Educational and Methodological Management Department
university_center_translations.about: Manage the university's educational work, organize the educational process according to curricula and programs established by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education and the Ministry of Science and Innovations, and improve the quality of personnel training.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Overall management of all activities and staff of the department;","Manage the university's educational work, organize the educational process according to curricula and programs established by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education and the Ministry of Science and Innovations;","Organize work on improving curricula and programs;","Organize monitoring of students\u2019 knowledge and skill levels through modern assessment methods. Based on the results, clarify educational thematic plans and define forms of individual work with students;","Monitor the implementation of curricula and workloads by the university\u2019s teaching staff;","Study and summarize modern and advanced practices;","Study the organization of the educational process at faculties, provide relevant instructions to faculty leadership to eliminate identified shortcomings based on monitoring results;","Organize professional development and experience gaining for young teachers;","Establish a database of information about teaching staff;","Monitor the implementation of plans for professional development of university teaching staff;","Participate in the distribution of employment for institute graduates in cooperation with the Personnel Training Department;","Manage pedagogical and industrial internships of students in accordance with the rules approved by the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialized Education of the Republic of Uzbekistan and monitor the implementation of internship plans;","Participate in the university admissions committee work, compile admissions information, and summarize admission results;","Study the activities of faculties and departments, summarize results, assess the relevance of departmental activities, and submit proposals for opening new departments;","Accept annual reports from faculties and departments."]

university_center_translations.name: O'quv-uslubiy boshqarma
university_center_translations.head: Aziz Khojiyev Kholmurodovich
university_center_translations.about: O'quv-uslubiy boshqarma universitetdagi o'quv jarayonlarini rejalashtirish, tashkil etish va muvofiqlashtirish bo'yicha asosiy tuzilma hisoblanadi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["O'quv rejalarini ishlab chiqish va ularni tasdiqlash;","Dars jadvallarini tuzish va darslarning borishini nazorat qilish;","O'quv yuklamalarini hisoblash va taqsimlash;","Pedagogik amaliyotlarni tashkil etish va nazorat qilish."]

university_center_translations.name: Учебно-методический отдел
university_center_translations.head: Азиз Ходжиев Холмуродович
university_center_translations.about: Управляет учебной работой университета, организует учебный процесс в соответствии с учебными планами и программами, контролирует выполнение учебной нагрузки преподавателями.

university_center_translations.name: القسم التعليمي والمنهجي
university_center_translations.head: عزيز خوجييف خولمرودوفيتش
university_center_translations.about: يدير العمل التعليمي بالجامعة وينظم العملية التدريسية وفق المناهج والخطط المعتمدة من وزارة التعليم العالي والعلوم والابتكارات، ويتابع تنفيذ الأعباء التدريسية للأساتذة.

university_center_translations.name: Master’s Department
university_center_translations.head: To'xtayeva Zebo Sharifovna
university_center_translations.about: The admission of students to master's specialties at the university began in the 1999-2000 academic year. The educational process at the master's department is well organized, with main focus on the educational-methodological support of subjects and the material-technical base.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Direct supervision of educational-methodological, spiritual-enlightenment, and scientific-research activities within the department;","Guiding master's students in conducting scientific research work and coordinating the research activities they undertake;","Monitoring the quality organization of master's students' internships, projects (works), master's theses, as well as their independent work;","Developing and implementing programs and projects aimed at the development of the master's program based on the assigned tasks;","Ensuring compliance with the Regulation on the Master's Program approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.","Master's students are fully involved in the scientific research work of the respective departments, and they also work as lab assistants, heads of cabinets, and assistant lecturers."]

university_center_translations.name: Magistratura bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: To'xtayeva Zebo Sharifovna
university_center_translations.about: Magistratura bo'limi universitetda magistrlar tayyorlash jarayonini muvofiqlashtiradi. U ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlari va o'quv jarayoni integratsiyasini ta'minlaydi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Magistraturada o'quv jarayonini tashkil etish;","Magistrlik dissertatsiyalari mavzularini tasdiqlash;","Ilmiy-pedagogik va ilmiy-tadqiqot amaliyotlarini o'tkazish;","Magistrlarni yakuniy attestatsiyadan o'tkazish ishlarini muvofiqlashtirish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел магистратуры
university_center_translations.head: Тухтаева Зебо Шарифовна
university_center_translations.about: Организует учебный, научно-исследовательский и духовно-просветительский процесс по специальностям магистратуры. В настоящее время в магистратуре обучается 308 студентов по 25 специальностям.

university_center_translations.name: إدارة الدراسات العليا (الماجستير)
university_center_translations.head: توختاييفا زيبو شريفوفنا
university_center_translations.about: تنظم وتنسق العملية التعليمية والبحثية لطلبة الماجستير في 25 تخصصاً أكاديمياً بالجامعة بالتوافق مع القرارات الحكومية المعتمدة. ويبلغ عدد المسجلين حالياً 308 طلاب.

university_center_translations.name: Department of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment
university_center_translations.head_title: Director of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment Department
university_center_translations.about: The main task of the Department of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment at the institute is to convey all the teachings of our President regarding spirituality, enlightenment, and national ideology to the youth. The main goal is to nurture students in the spirit of loyalty to national and universal values.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Forming students into true citizens of the independent Republic of Uzbekistan based on national and universal values;","Preparing students to sincerely fulfill their civic and filial duties towards the Motherland; increasing students\u2019 sense of responsibility in mastering their professions;","Developing and improving the individual qualities of students as unique personalities; promoting students\u2019 social activity, initiative, and sense of social responsibility;","Developing students\u2019 socio-political and legal consciousness, and expanding their critical and analytical thinking skills;","Educating students about the consequences of negative traits such as injustice, bribery, and localism;","Organizing students\u2019 leisure time meaningfully and supporting their scientific and creative activities based on their interests;","Improving targeted spiritual, moral, and educational work.","Establishing moral, aesthetic, political, legal, and artistic education among student youth;","Organizing conferences, round tables, and meetings dedicated to promoting national customs and values;","Forming ideological immunity in students against religious extremism, terrorism, drug addiction, and organized crime;","Increasing youth interest in music, painting, literature, theater, and other arts, and promoting reading culture among them."]

university_center_translations.name: Yoshlar bilan ishlash, ma'naviyat va ma'rifat bo'limi
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim talaba-yoshlar o'rtasida ma'naviy-ma'rifiy ishlarni tashkil etadi, ularning bo'sh vaqtlarini mazmunli o'tkazish choralarini ko'radi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Talabalar o'rtasida vatanparvarlik va ma'naviy qadriyatlarni targ'ib qilish;","Turli tanlovlar, festivallar va uchrashuvlar tashkil etish;","Talabalar yotoqxonalarida ma'naviy tadbirlar o'tkazish;","Yoshlarni yot g'oyalar ta'siridan himoya qilish ishlarini olib borish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел по работе с молодежью, духовности и просвещения
university_center_translations.about: Главной задачей отдела является воспитание студентов в духе патриотизма, верности национальным ценностям, развитие их духовно-просветительского мировоззрения и содержательная организация досуга.

university_center_translations.name: قسم شؤون الشباب والأنشطة الروحية والتربوية
university_center_translations.about: يهدف القسم إلى غرس القيم الوطنية والإنسانية في نفوس الطلاب وتطوير وعيهم الثقافي والاجتماعي وحمايتهم من الأفكار المتطرفة، وتنظيم أوقات الفراغ بما يفيد نشاطهم الإبداعي والعلمي.

university_center_translations.name: Department for Organizing Scientific Research Activities of Talented Students
university_center_translations.head: Bahriniso Baxtiyorovna To'raqulova
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Department for Organizing Scientific Research Activities of Talented Students
university_center_translations.about: The purpose of organizing and developing students' scientific research work and activities is to enhance students' knowledge in relevant academic fields, increase their scientific abilities and creative freedom, as well as to cultivate and develop their initiative.
university_center_translations.functions: ["To establish and regularly update a unified database of talented and initiative youth in higher education institutions and ensure their collaboration with the country's leading scientists and businesspeople;","To identify the intellectual potential of talented students;","To organize targeted training of talented students based on their abilities and preferences;","To support and develop innovative projects, and direct initiative youth towards entrepreneurial activities through the establishment of scientific-innovative accelerators and business incubators;","To assist talented youth in gaining experience at reputable scientific centers, universities, technoparks, and production enterprises in developed foreign countries;","To form new generation scientific communities and schools in relevant fields at higher education institutions;","To build academic teams that will find their place in the scientific community and contribute to the prestige of national science in the future;","To provide conditions for mastering various methods, directions, and skills in conducting scientific research work;","To ensure active participation of talented students in republican and international scientific Olympiads, state scholarships, and awards competitions;","To help students learn independent problem-solving methods and develop their ability to work in scientific teams;","To involve students widely in scientific research projects carried out at higher education institutions;","To assist in achieving quality and efficiency in selecting talented youth for postgraduate education stages.","To organize scientific-creative clubs for talented students and provide appropriate conditions for their scientific-creative research;","To organize elections of Youth Academy leaders in cooperation with the Department of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment, and support their activities;","To widely involve students in defending startup projects and rationalization ideas as graduation qualification works and master's theses;"]

university_center_translations.name: Iqtidorli talabalarning ilmiy-tadqiqot faoliyatini tashkil etish bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Bahriniso Baxtiyorovna To'raqulova
university_center_translations.head_title: Iqtidorli talabalar bilan ishlash bo'limi boshlig'i
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim universitetdagi iqtidorli talabalarni aniqlash, ularni ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlariga jalb qilish va olimpiadalarga tayyorlash bilan shug'ullanadi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Iqtidorli talabalar bazasini shakllantirish va yangilab borish;","Talabalarni fan olimpiadalari va tanlovlarga tayyorlash;","Ilmiy to'garaklar faoliyatini muvofiqlashtirish;","Talabalarning ilmiy maqolalar nashr etishlariga ko'maklashish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел по организации научно-исследовательской деятельности одаренных студентов
university_center_translations.head: Бахринисо Бахтиёровна Туракулова
university_center_translations.head_title: Начальник отдела по работе с одаренными студентами
university_center_translations.about: Занимается выявлением одаренных студентов, развитием их интеллектуального потенциала и вовлечением в научные и инновационные проекты.

university_center_translations.name: قسم تنظيم الأنشطة البحثية للطلاب الموهوبين
university_center_translations.head: بحرينيسو باختياروفنا توراقولوفا
university_center_translations.head_title: رئيسة قسم تنظيم الأنشطة البحثية للطلاب الموهوبين
university_center_translations.about: يهدف القسم إلى رعاية واكتشاف الطاقات الفكرية والإبداعية والابتكارية لدى الطلاب وتوجيههم نحو النشاط البحثي والمشاريع الناشئة.

university_center_translations.name: International Cooperation Department
university_center_translations.head: Nodir Karomatjonovich Mastonov
university_center_translations.about: Manages the operational international partnerships, international student admissions, and exchange program logistics under the direction of the Vice-Rector for International Cooperation.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Process international student inquiries and manage admissions paperwork","Administer logistics for incoming and outgoing exchange professors and students","Organize global research workshops and international delegation visits","Maintain databases of active international memorandums and double-degree agreements"]

university_center_translations.name: Xalqaro hamkorlik bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Nodir Karomatjonovich Mastonov
university_center_translations.about: Xalqaro hamkorlik bo'limi chet el universitetlari bilan aloqalarni o'rnatadi, qo'shma ta'lim dasturlari, talabalar va o'qituvchilar almashinuvini tashkil qiladi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Xalqaro shartnomalar va memorandumlar imzolash;","Xorijiy delegatsiyalarni qabul qilish va tashriflarni tashkil etish;","Xalqaro loyihalar va grantlarda ishtirok etish;","Xorijiy talabalar va professorlarni jalb qilish ishlarini muvofiqlashtirish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел международного сотрудничества
university_center_translations.head: Нодир Кароматжонович Мастонов
university_center_translations.about: Курирует международные связи университета, иностранные контракты, прием зарубежных студентов и академический обмен.

university_center_translations.name: قسم التعاون الدولي
university_center_translations.head: نادر كرامتجونوفيتش مستونوف
university_center_translations.about: يشرف على العلاقات الدولية للجامعة، العقود والاتفاقيات الخارجية، قبول الطلاب الأجانب وبرامج التبادل الأكاديمي.

university_center_translations.name: Anti-Corruption Compliance Control System Management Department
university_center_translations.head: Sherali Zayniyev
university_center_translations.about: Ensures academic integrity, prevents conflicts of interest, and coordinates anti-corruption guidelines across all examinations, admissions, and financial operations at BSTU.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Monitor examinations and grading transparency to prevent academic misconduct","Administer anonymous channels for reporting corruption or ethical violations","Conduct ethical compliance training for all academic and administrative staff","Investigate compliance complaints and report findings directly to the Rector and Senate"]

university_center_translations.name: Korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish "komplayens-nazorat" tizimini boshqarish bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Sherali Zayniyev
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim universitetda korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish choralarini ko'radi, korrupsion holatlarning oldini olish tizimini boshqaradi va shaffoflikni ta'minlaydi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Universitet faoliyatida korrupsiyaviy xavf-xatarlarni aniqlash va baholash;","Korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish bo'yicha tushuntirish ishlarini olib borish;","Murojaatlar va korrupsion holatlar haqidagi xabarlarni ko'rib chiqish;","Imtihonlar va qabul jarayonlarida shaffoflikni ta'minlash."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел управления системой комплаенс-контроля по противодействию коррупции
university_center_translations.head: Шерали Зайниев
university_center_translations.about: Обеспечивает соблюдение академической честности, предотвращение конфликта интересов и прозрачность всех экзаменов и финансовых процедур в университете.

university_center_translations.name: قسم إدارة نظام الرقابة والامتثال لمكافحة الفساد
university_center_translations.head: شيرالي زاينيف
university_center_translations.head_title: رئيس قسم الرقابة والامتثال لمكافحة الفساد
university_center_translations.about: يضمن الالتزام التام بالأمانة الأكاديمية وتجنب تضارب المصالح وشفافية كافة الامتحانات والمعاملات المالية بالجامعة.

university_center_translations.name: The Initial Organization of the Youth Union of Uzbekistan
university_center_translations.head: Akbar Azamatjonov
university_center_translations.head_title: Youth Leader of the Primary Organization
university_center_translations.about: The Primary Organization of the Youth Union of Uzbekistan at Bukhara State Technical University was established on October 3, 2017. The Council of the Primary Organization consists of 13 members and youth leaders from seven faculties.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Youth Leader of the Primary Organization of the Youth Union of Uzbekistan","First Deputy Youth Leader","Leader of the Direction for Working with Active and Talented Youth","Leader of the Initiative and Youth Entrepreneurship Direction","Leader of the Direction for Monitoring the Quality of the Educational Process","Leader of the Direction for Working with Students Admitted After Completing Mandatory Military Service","Deputy Youth Leader for Spiritual and Educational Affairs","Leader of the Spiritual and Educational Affairs and Youth Tourism Direction","Leader of the Sports and Health Direction","Leader of the Direction for Working with Socially Vulnerable Students and Students with Disabilities","Leader of the Organizational Control and Human Resources Direction","Press Secretary and Head of the Youth Media Group","Leader of the Direction for Working with Students\u2019 Appeals (operating on a voluntary basis)"]

university_center_translations.name: O'zbekiston Yoshlar ittifoqi boshlang'ich tashkiloti
university_center_translations.head: Akbar Azamatjonov
university_center_translations.about: Yoshlar ittifoqi boshlang'ich tashkiloti talabalarni birlashtiradi, ularning ijtimoiy va ijodiy tashabbuslarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi hamda yetakchilik qobiliyatlarini rivojlantiradi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Talabalar ittifoqini mustahkamlash va faolligini oshirish;","Yoshlar loyihalari va tadbirkorlik tashabbuslarini qo'llab-quvvatlash;","Ko'ngillilar harakatini tashkil etish;","Yoshlarning huquq va manfaatlarini himoya qilish."]

university_center_translations.name: Первичная организация Союза молодежи Узбекистана
university_center_translations.head: Акбар Азаматжонов
university_center_translations.about: Первичная организация Союза молодежи Узбекистана в Бухарском государственном техническом университете создана в 2017 году. Защищает права и интересы молодежи, развивает их творческий и интеллектуальный потенциал.

university_center_translations.name: المنظمة الأولية لاتحاد شبيبة أوزبكستان
university_center_translations.head: أكبر عظمتجونوف
university_center_translations.about: تأسست المنظمة الأولية لاتحاد شبيبة أوزبكستان بالجامعة عام 2017. تدافع عن حقوق ومصالح الطلاب وتعمل على رعاية قدراتهم وإدماجهم في المجتمع.

university_center_translations.name: Department of Civil and Labor Protection
university_center_translations.head: Yuldash Qodirovich Malikov
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Department of Civil and Labor Protection
university_center_translations.about: The Department of Civil and Labor Protection coordinates civil defense plans, emergency drills, safety protocols, and labor protection engineering parameters across the campus. It supervises industrial hygiene, hazard prevention, and accident investigations.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Analyze the state and causes of accidents and occupational diseases at the university, develop measures in cooperation with the relevant university service to prevent accidents and occupational diseases, and implement the established measures;","Participate in the implementation of labor safety standards and scientific developments related to labor protection;","Organize the participation of engineers, technicians, and service staff in the certification commission for checking compliance with labor protection rules, regulations, and instructions;","Provide methodological assistance in developing and reviewing labor protection instructions, and participate in creating programs to train workers on safe working practices;","Participate in investigating accidents during the educational process and production;","Take part in the activities of the final commission and the university's asset commission;","Prepare draft orders related to labor protection issues;","Hold advisory councils for students and staff on labor protection matters;","Review letters, applications, and complaints related to labor protection from students and staff, and take appropriate measures;","Maintain documentation according to the prescribed list of work;","Prepare labor protection reports in the prescribed form and order."]

university_center_translations.name: Fuqaro muhofazasi va mehnat muhofazasi bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Yuldash Qodirovich Malikov
university_center_translations.head_title: Fuqaro muhofazasi va mehnat muhofazasi bo'limi boshlig'i
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim universitet hududida xavfsizlik qoidalariga rioya etilishini, mehnat muhofazasi va fuqaro mudofaasi tadbirlarini rejalashtirish hamda tashkil etishni ta'minlaydi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Mehnat xavfsizligi va texnikasi qoidalariga rioya qilinishini nazorat qilish;","Favqulodda vaziyatlarda harakat qilish bo'yicha o'quv mashg'ulotlarini o'tkazish;","Yong'in xavfsizligi tizimlarini doimiy nazorat qilib borish;","Xodimlar va talabalarga mehnat xavfsizligi bo'yicha yo'riqnomalar berish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел гражданской защиты и охраны труда
university_center_translations.head: Юлдаш Кодирович Маликов
university_center_translations.about: Координирует планы гражданской обороны, проведение тренировок по действиям в ЧС, правила техники безопасности и охраны труда в кампусе.

university_center_translations.name: قسم الحماية المدنية والسلامة والصحة المهنية
university_center_translations.head: يولداش قديروفيتش ماليكوف
university_center_translations.about: يختص بمراقبة وتطبيق معايير السلامة المهنية وتجنب حوادث العمل وتنظيم إجراءات الحماية المدنية بالحرم الجامعي، وإجراء التحقيقات الأمنية.

university_center_translations.name: Legal Service Department
university_center_translations.head: Sadikov Otamurod Tuymurodovich
university_center_translations.head_title: Head of the Legal Service Department
university_center_translations.about: Supervises all draft orders, decisions, and decrees issued by the university and ensures that each issued order, decision, and decree is properly formalized in accordance with current laws and regulations.
university_center_translations.functions: ["To supervise all draft orders, decisions, and decrees issued by the university and ensure that each issued order, decision, and decree is properly formalized in accordance with current laws and regulations;","To verify the compliance of orders, instructions, and other documents submitted for the rector\u2019s signature with legal requirements;","To ensure that all university documents comply with national and international legislation, and in cases of legal contradictions, to take measures to annul or amend them;","To participate in the preparation and formalization of collective agreements;","To ensure the proper drafting and lawful execution of contracts concluded between the university and other organizations;","To assist in raising the legal awareness and legal literacy of university professors, staff, and management, communicating the content and essence of adopted normative-legal documents;","To receive citizens and university employees on legal matters and provide them with legal advice;","To replenish the university\u2019s normative-legal document fund, including enriching the fund with codes, laws, commentaries, newsletters, and other legal publications;","To maintain a systematic record of normative-legal documents received by and issued by the university in accordance with established requirements;","To submit proposals and, if necessary, participate in measures to eliminate violations of laws identified within the university;","When required, to defend the rights of university professors and employees in law enforcement agencies and courts;","To cooperate with other departments in addressing the university\u2019s accounts receivable;","To participate in the discussion of commission proposals reviewing the results of the university\u2019s educational, scientific, and economic-financial activities;","To prepare relevant documents to be submitted to authorized state bodies regarding violations at the university, and to take measures to recover damages;","To promote newly adopted laws, decisions, decrees, orders, and other normative-legal acts among university staff;","To have a strong knowledge of information and communication technologies;","To comply with the university\u2019s internal rules, codes of conduct, and dress code requirements."]

university_center_translations.name: Yuridik xizmat
university_center_translations.head: Sadikov Otamurod Tuymurodovich
university_center_translations.about: Yuridik xizmat universitet faoliyatida qonuniylikni ta'minlaydi, buyruqlar va shartnomalar loyihalarini huquqiy ekspertizadan o'tkazadi hamda universitet manfaatlarini sudda himoya qiladi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Universitet hujjatlarining qonun hujjatlariga muvofiqligini ta'minlash;","Shartnomalar va bitimlar loyihalarini huquqiy ekspertizadan o'tkazish;","Mehnat munosabatlarida qonun hujjatlariga rioya qilinishini nazorat qilish;","Sud va nizolarda universitet huquqlari va manfaatlarini himoya qilish."]

university_center_translations.name: Юридический отдел
university_center_translations.head: Садиков Отамурод Туймуродович
university_center_translations.about: Контролирует соответствие приказов, решений и договоров администрации университета действующему законодательству Республики Узбекистан.

university_center_translations.name: قسم الخدمات القانونية
university_center_translations.head: صادقوف أوتامورود تويمورودوفيتش
university_center_translations.about: يشرف على مطابقة كافة القرارات واللوائح والعقود الصادرة عن الجامعة للقوانين والتشريعات الوطنية النافذة بجمهورية أوزبكستان وحماية مصالح الجامعة القانونية.

university_center_translations.name: Department of Scientific Research, Innovations, and Training of Scientific-Pedagogical Staff
university_center_translations.head: Rakhmatov Shukhrat Akhatovich
university_center_translations.about: The Department of Scientific Research and Training of Scientific-Pedagogical Staff was established in 1982. It is managed by the Head of Department and operates within the scope of the Vice-Rector for Scientific Work and Innovations of the university. Up to the present day, the department has been led by various professors and instructors.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Organizing and coordinating scientific research activities at the university;","Effectively utilizing the university's scientific potential to solve scientific and scientific-technical problems in the development of the national economy;","Developing scientific research in the creation of new materials, equipment, and technologies;","Improving the quality of specialists being trained by applying the results of scientific research to the educational process;","Strengthening the material and technical base of scientific research work;","Integrating efforts to create competitive technologies and equipment based on the development of scientific and technical cooperation.","Applying fundamental and applied research results to production and the educational process, and strengthening the university\u2019s material base.","Supporting information technology, marketing, patent-licensing, consulting, and the production of small-scale scientific and technical products."]

university_center_translations.name: Ilmiy tadqiqotlar, innovatsiyalar va ilmiy-pedagogik kadrlarni tayyorlash bo'limi
university_center_translations.head: Rakhmatov Shukhrat Akhatovich
university_center_translations.about: Bo'lim universitetdagi ilmiy tadqiqotlar, doktorantura (PhD va DSc) tizimi, innovatsion loyihalar va patentlash ishlarini muvofiqlashtiradi.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Doktorantlar va mustaqil tadqiqotchilar faoliyatini tashkil etish;","Ilmiy loyihalar, davlat grantlari va innovatsion loyihalarni boshqarish;","Ilmiy konferensiyalar, seminarlar va simpoziumlar tashkil etish;","Ilmiy maqolalar, darsliklar va monografiyalar chop etilishini nazorat qilish."]

university_center_translations.name: Отдел научных исследований, инноваций и подготовки научно-педагогических кадров
university_center_translations.head: Рахматов Шухрат Ахатович
university_center_translations.about: Отдел основан в 1982 году, руководит научно-исследовательской деятельностью университета, подготовкой научных кадров и координирует научно-техническое сотрудничество с производственными предприятиями.

university_center_translations.name: قسم البحث العلمي والابتكارات وتدريب الكوادر العلمية والتربوية
university_center_translations.head: رحمتوف شوهرت أحادوفيتش
university_center_translations.about: تأسس القسم العلمي عام 1982، ويشرف على تنظيم وتنسيق أنشطة البحث العلمي والابتكار وإعداد كوادر الدكتوراه والماجستير بالجامعة، وربط البحوث بالقطاع الصناعي والإنتاجي.

university_center_translations.name: Information and Resource Center
university_center_translations.head: Barno S. Rahmatova
university_center_translations.head_title: Director of the Information and Resource Center
university_center_translations.about: The Information Resource Center serves as the central library and digital database for Bukhara State Technical University. The center houses over 250,000 physical scientific volumes, textbook materials, and journals, alongside a high-tech computer lab offering digital research database access.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Maintain physical and digital textbook catalogs for all courses","Provide scientific research database access (e.g. Scopus, Web of Science)","Organize book exhibitions, cultural seminars, and student reading campaigns","Offer quiet study areas and collaborative workspaces for research"]

university_center_translations.name: Axborot-resurs markazi (Kutubxona)
university_center_translations.head: Barno S. Rahmatova
university_center_translations.about: Axborot-resurs markazi talabalar, magistrlar, doktorantlar va professor-o'qituvchilarni darsliklar, ilmiy adabiyotlar va elektron resurslar bilan ta'minlovchi kutubxonadir.
university_center_translations.functions: ["Kutubxona fondini yangi adabiyotlar bilan boyitish;","Elektron kutubxona tizimini (ARM) yuritish va takomillashtirish;","Kitobxonlarga xizmat ko'rsatish va o'quv zallari faoliyatini tashkil etish;","Ilmiy ma'lumotlar bazalaridan (Scopus, ScienceDirect) foydalanish imkoniyatini ta'minlash."]

university_center_translations.name: Информационно-ресурсный центр (Библиотека)
university_center_translations.head: Барно С. Рахматова
university_center_translations.about: Является центральной библиотекой университета. Фонд центра насчитывает более 250 000 печатных и электронных изданий, обеспечивает доступ к международным базам данных (Scopus, Web of Science).

university_center_translations.name: مركز مصادر المعلومات (المكتبة المركزية)
university_center_translations.head: بارنو س. رحمتوفا
university_center_translations.about: يعد المكتبة المركزية للجامعة. يضم المركز أكثر من 250 ألف كتاب ومراجع علمية، ويوفر إمكانية الوصول إلى قواعد البيانات الدولية مثل Scopus و Web of Science.

document_requirements.name: Secondary School Transcript
document_requirements.description: Secondary grades transcript if separate from certificate.

document_requirements.name: Proof of Enrollment
document_requirements.description: Student status certificate from previous university.
